body:
Friend, did you see our email?
---
Now that Deb is the **official** Democratic nominee for Governor of New Mexico, your support is _more important than ever before._ **[Please, don’t miss your chance to be one of the FIRST in the general election to endorse Deb's campaign for Governor of New Mexico before midnight: Add your name!](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/em_mw_202606_endorse?source=jtk837-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&t=1&akid=10113%2E400544%2EssvoaW)**

---
Thank you,
Team Haaland
\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: **Team Haaland**
Date: Wed, Jun 3, 2026
Subject: will you personally endorse Deb's campaign?
| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=3&akid=10113%2E400544%2EssvoaW)
---
We've got HUGE news, friend: **Deb is officially the Democratic nominee for Governor of New Mexico!**
This is an incredible milestone, but the fight ahead starts now. National Republicans and GOP megadonors are already preparing to spend millions to flip New Mexico red, and we need to show that this grassroots movement is ready for whatever comes next.
**_
[That’s why we want you to be one of the FIRST in the general election to endorse Deb's campaign for Governor of New Mexico before midnight: Add your name!](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/em_mw_202606_endorse?refcode=jtk837-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&t=4&akid=10113%2E400544%2EssvoaW)_**

---
Deb understands the toughest challenges facing our state, from housing to healthcare. She knows firsthand that the system isn’t working for people the way it should — and that's because that’s been her experience most of her life.
Now more than ever, New Mexico needs a strong leader who is ready to fight from day one to lower costs, protect our freedoms, and make government work better for everyone.

But Deb can't do it alone, friend. We’re building a people-powered movement strong enough to take on the GOP’s attacks and keep New Mexico moving forward — and your endorsement tonight matters. ** _[So please, before midnight tonight, will you be one of the 10,000 supporters we need to endorse Deb Haaland's campaign?](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/em_mw_202606_endorse?refcode=jtk837-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&t=6&akid=10113%2E400544%2EssvoaW)_**

In 2024, I ran for Congress in Maryland. I fought as hard as I knew how. I knocked on doors, made calls, and connected with voters.
The voters who heard my message? They were with me.
_The problem was getting heard at all._
Dark money donors spent MILLIONS of dollars to drown me out, and it worked. I watched it happen in real time — ads I couldn't match, mailers I couldn't answer, and a wall of money between me and the voters I was trying to reach.
When you have that kind of money, you don't have to win the argument. You just have to make sure the other side can't be heard.
I could've walked away. God knows it would've been easier.
But I filed to run again.
**I stood inside the United States Capitol on January 6th and watched Donald Trump's mob try to tear our democracy apart with their bare hands. I held the line that day. I testified. I fought back with everything I had.**
And I'll be damned if I let dark money and MAGA intimidation knock me down.
I'm running for this district, for this state, and for the idea that our democracy is worth defending even when it's hard. Especially when it's hard.
That means standing up to Donald Trump. It means standing up to the billionaires and the PACs and the anonymous money that's quietly buying our elections out from under us.

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: Haaland vs Hull
body:
Plus: Why this race could be over by the Fourth of July | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/Xm6aAfAt63u?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
`Gregg Hull just won the GOP nomination for New Mexico governor in a real stunner — outspent 3-to-1 by Doug Turner, who had been closing fast in the final week. [He outlasted both Turner and Duke Rodriguez](https://us.list-manage.com/o1rgMvAFLIH?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) by riding huge support across the Albuquerque metro.``
``**Now it's Hull vs. Haaland** — and she just buried Sam Bregman in a primary blowout of her own.`
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/rVR_FvHbLgg?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
**🔥 HULL TAKES THE GOP — KRYSTY WAS RIGHT!**
Turner outspent Hull 3-to-1. Pre-election polling had Turner closing fast. Most everyone expected him to win.
Most everyone except Krysty. She made the call a couple shows back — and we play the clip in this episode.
There's one question Jay and Mark dig into that nobody else is asking: did the third candidate hand Hull the nomination without even meaning to?

**🔵 HAALAND THUMPS BREGMAN — NOW SHE GOES UNDERGROUND**
Deb Haaland buried Sam Bregman in a primary blowout. She now has $2 million in the bank and a strategy that's going to drive every Republican in the state insane.
Jay's words on her general election plan: she's going to make Joe Biden look like the greatest retail politician ever.
And the warning Jay delivers next should keep Hull's team up at night.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/hEi57dCu58I?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | **🎯 HULL'S PUNCHER'S CHANCE — AND THE 2006 PLAYBOOK**
Hull has a path. Mark and Jay walk through it — and Jay keeps coming back to one race: Heather Wilson, 2006.
The catch is a -26 generic ballot in Albuquerque. Hull starts the general in a deep hole. And Jay says if he doesn't move fast, this race could be over by the Fourth of July.

**😬 THE MAINE SENATE CANDIDATE WITH A 20-YEAR NAZI TATTOO**
A Nazi tattoo on his chest. For 20 years. He says it was an accident.
Reddit posts. Sexually explicit messages with other women while married. A wife sent to defend him publicly.
His name is Graham Platner. Democrats are sticking with him because they need to take out Susan Collins. You'll want to hear Mark on this one.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/jSsLfZTdpuS?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)

Peter,

the general election after AIPAC and Big Tech dropped more than $1 million
to attack him in the final days of this heated race for Nancy Pelosi’s
U.S. House seat.

The progressive primary movement we have today wouldn't be possible
without Saikat's leadership. We are proud to be in this fight with him,
always.

Thank you, Saikat, for challenging the Democratic establishment head-on,
building the biggest ground game San Francisco has ever seen, and being
committed to growing the movement to build true power for working people.

There's no clearer sign you're running a campaign that challenges the
billionaire class to deliver a better future for working families than
when AI & Crypto billionaires tag team with AIPAC donors to defeat you.

Though we didn’t get the results we wanted in this race, it’s looking
promising that Mai Vang and Angela Gonzales-Torres will advance to the
general election in Sacramento (CA-07) and Los Angeles (CA-34).

Votes are still being counted, but we need your support to quickly help

“When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD will lift up a standard against him.”
| | When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD will lift up a standard against him.
~ Isaiah 59:19
---
I'm sure I don't really need to tell you this, but we're in a spiritual battle. This isn't a game or some kind of hyperbole; the soul of our nation is on the line right now.
The other day, I read and reflected on Isaiah 59:19. The passage reads: When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD will lift up a standard against him.
Unfortunately, sick and godless ideology is festering in our nation today. Liberal billionaires and coastal elites have bankrolled monsters in their scheme to take the House Majority and thrust America into chaos.
My Team and I are fighting to defend the House majority from these lunatics. If we fail in Congress, our nation will quickly fall to this insidious evil too.
Listen, I'm not going to tell you this will be easy. Protecting our Christian way of life, our children, and our shared values is a tall order. But this short excerpt from Isaiah reminded me that with the Lord on our side, we shall overcome all that stands against us!

The passage reads: When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD will lift up a standard against him. Unfortunately, sick and godless ideology is festering in our nation today. Liberal billionaires and coastal elites have bankrolled monsters in their scheme to take the House Majority and thrust America into chaos. My Team and I are fighting to defend the House majority from these lunatics. If we fail in Congress, our nation will quickly fall to this insidious evil too. Listen, I'm not going to tell you this will be easy. Protecting our Christian way of life, our children, and our shared values is a tall order. But this short excerpt from Isaiah reminded me that with the Lord on our side, we shall overcome all that stands against us! No matter what my role was, from Navy SEAL to husband and father, I have always led with the light of Christ and that's not about to change when we defend the House in November. This past weekend, I won the official Republican Party of Minnesota endorsement for the United States Senate. Now the real battle begins — and I’m asking you to stand with me.

My name is Adam Schwarze._**I’m a former Navy SEAL and Marine Corps veteran who joined the military right after 9/11.**_ I fought in the Battle of Najaf in Iraq and deployed nine times to over 70 countries in defense of this nation. I’m not a career politician — I’m a regular guy from a working-class family who answered the call to serve.

There are two very different futures on the ballot:

**My vision:**
* Secure borders and a peace through strength national defense
* Law and order with full support for our police
* Lower taxes and less government burden on families and small businesses

The general election in California starts now , and I’m proud to be running for re-election to serve as your California Attorney General.
Californians are facing unprecedented challenges. Our fight against relentless attacks from the Trump administration, threats from corporations that think they’re above the law, and rising costs requires a leader with battle-tested experience.
Our next Attorney General has to be ready on day one to shield Californians from brazen attacks on our rights and our families, and continue the critical work of holding accountable bad actors attempting to harm, defraud, or scam the people of our state.
If you’re with me in this fight, I’m asking you to become a day one donor to our general election campaign by contributing any amount right now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]
Over the last five years, we’ve built a wall of protection around this state. A legal fortress around our freedoms and our values that not even the most unlawful president can tear down.
We’ve put public safety first, and successfully combatted fentanyl traffickers, gun traffickers, and human traffickers.
We’ve held corporations accountable for breaking the law, from Big Tech hurting our children for their own profit to Big Oil’s deceptive practices to Big Landlords colluding to drive up prices.
Through it all, we’re defending our rights, freedoms, and democracy from the ongoing assault of a federal government and President who are hell-bent on tearing them down.
Since his second term began, we’ve sued Donald Trump 68 times — and we’ve won. Again and again and again.
The message is clear: the rule of law is still intact, and remains our best defense against the reckless and dangerous actions of Donald Trump and his corrupt administration — that’s why I am laser-focused on earning another term as your Attorney General.
Together we fight, together we lead — and together, we must finish the job.
I am fiercely committed to doing whatever it takes to stop unlawful power grabs from the federal government, defend our immigrant communities, protect reproductive freedom, safeguard our environment, hold corporations accountable, keep our communities safe from gun violence and fentanyl, and stand up to abuse of power wherever it appears — and to do all that, I’ll need you with me.
Today, as we kick off the general election, please join the fight and become a day one donor. No amount is too small — your contributions add up to make all of this work possible. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for being a part of this team and our movement for freedom and justice for all.
—Rob

| Rebecca Bennett here. I just became the Democratic nominee for New Jersey's 7th Congressional District, which means I am officially facing off against Tom Kean Jr. in one of the nation's closest toss-up districts.

[Before I tell you more, will you split a donation between me and the Voter Protection Project to help unseat a vulnerable MAGA extremist and flip the House blue in November? ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/110585?t=6&akid=24763%2E878179%2EflCo3W) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Rebecca Bennett and Voter Protection Project will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/110586?t=7&akid=24763%2E878179%2EflCo3W)

[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/110600?t=11&akid=24763%2E878179%2EflCo3W)
If this is the first you're hearing from me, hi 👋

**I'm a former U.S. Navy helicopter pilot, officer in the Air National Guard, business leader in healthcare, and proud mom to my two daughters.**
[](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/110585?t=12&akid=24763%2E878179%2EflCo3W)
I entered this race for the same reason I joined the military: I love this country.

I was serving on active duty in the military the first time Trump was elected. Seeing the path he sent us on, I knew I had to get involved in politics. As soon as I got out of the military, I started volunteering, door-knocking, and phone banking.

Then Trump got elected _again._

**I knew in that moment no one was coming to save us. I had to throw myself at this problem. For my daughters, for their generation, for the future of the country I love.**

Congress is failing us. It's time to remember that we're the ones cutting their checks. Tom Kean Jr. has proven himself unfit to lead. It's time for him to step aside for someone who has what it takes to stand up to extremism, lower costs, and defend our rights and freedoms.

The Republican establishment tried _hard_ to prevent me from taking home the win last night, but we won out.

I'm not scared of a challenge. I landed aircraft in the middle of the ocean with one foot of clearance in the pitch dark. They can throw whatever they want at us, but I'm not going anywhere.

**I can't wait to show them just who they picked a fight with, and I'd love to have you by my side.**

[Can the Voter Protection Project and I count on you to split a donation to support my General Election Fund? I am up against MAGA millionaires and shady special interest groups vying to buy our voice, and we need all the grassroots strength we can muster to fight back and win in November. ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/110585?t=13&akid=24763%2E878179%2EflCo3W)
[JOIN THE TEAM »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/110585?t=14&akid=24763%2E878179%2EflCo3W)
---
Thanks for being here!
-Rebecca

name: Kshama for Congress
subject: Kshama is the only consistent antiwar, pro-worker candidate in this race
body:
Working people don’t need more “team players” in Congress, we need a proven fighter

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/kshamasawant/socialists-for-kshama-13701851?e=bbdb764b3a)
---
| | | | | | Dear Peter,
There are now two Democrats and one Republican running against socialist Kshama Sawant in the Congressional District 9 race for Washington state.
---
|
---
| |

**Kshama is the only consistent antiwar, pro-worker candidate in this race.**
**She is the only candidate in the race with a track record of defeating billionaires and winning working-class victories.**
---
| [DONATE TODAY](https://us.list-manage.com/xlLtoadrMDv?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
---
| [VOLUNTEER](https://us.list-manage.com/12RP5Mlyhym?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
---
| |
Democrat #1 is incumbent Adam Smith, who has spent his nearly three decades in office openly promoting endless war and being bankrolled by the weapons industry, AIPAC, and Big Tech executives. Smith has voted repeatedly to fund the genocide in Gaza and to block United Nations food aid to Gaza. He voted in December of 2025 to give Trump $906 billion for war — money that Trump has been using for the war on Iran and to fund Israel’s assault on Lebanon. Smith has voted to create and fund ICE. He also voted to slash Medicare and Medicaid funding by hundreds of billions of dollars. **Adam Smith needs to go!**
Both the Democratic and Republican parties are using every avenue to try to block Kshama from becoming the first revolutionary socialist in Congress.
**The Republican who filed in the race, Doug Basler, publicly admitted that he was recruited to try to keep Kshama out of Congress.** As he entered the race, two other Republicans conveniently dropped out, clearing the field for Basler to get the entire Republican vote.
It’s not surprising the Republican leadership strongly prefers Adam Smith to Kshama Sawant, since Smith has been a dogged representative of the war profiteers, Zionist lobby, and the billionaire class. **As one right-wing commenter**[**remarked**](https://us.list-manage.com/yipF2PsuzG0?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)**, Smith “sounds more like a Republican than a lot of Republicans.”** For the Republican Party, this is not about defeating neoliberal warmonger Smith. No Republican has broken 30 percent of the vote against Smith in 15 years, including Basler himself, who has previously run against Smith many times.
Just this week, Adam Smith and Republican Mike Rogers, the chair of the House Armed Services Committee, jointly announced a new bipartisan war spending bill. **If passed next week, it would mean over a trillion new dollars for wars and a shocking expansion in AI, cyber, biotech, and other weapons for Israel.**
Smith shamelessly serves the war profiteers.
Democrat #2 in the race is Melissa Chaudhry. While purportedly running as an alternative to establishment Democrat Adam Smith, Chaudhry is running a remarkably establishment-friendly campaign.
Chaudhry has a detailed “Issues” page on her website, but **nowhere on it does she call for universal public healthcare or Medicare for All.** She does not call for an end to military aid to Israel. **The words “genocide,” “Gaza,” or “Israel,” or “occupation” do not even appear on that page. Nowhere does she call to abolish or shut down ICE or to stop the deportations.** She merely objects to detaining people “without process,” complaining that “that is not immigration enforcement.” **Chaudhry does not demand student debt cancellation,** instead saying “Cap repayments at 5% of discretionary income.” None of what Chaudhry is calling for is a threat to the Democratic Party establishment.
**Kshama is the only candidate fighting for:**
* **Free universal public healthcare**
* **End all military aid to Israel**
* **Shut down ICE and the detention centers**
* **Stop the data centers**
* **Cancel student and medical debt**
* **Fight AI-related layoffs with a public-sector, living-wage jobs guarantee**
* **National rent control**

These positions are supported by tens of millions of working people, but are frightening to the billionaires and both their political parties.
It’s no accident that Democratic Party candidates don’t run on demands like Kshama’s, because they are trying to build careers and don’t want to antagonize powerful people. They instead speak in vague generalities to which they can’t be held accountable. They know that running a campaign like Kshama’s would put them at odds with party powerbrokers and the billionaires and multimillionaires they serve.
Chaudhry recently spoke at a Democratic Party event, which included a mix of candidates, party establishment stalwarts like Democratic State Senator Jamie Pedersen, activists, and party insiders. **She announced to those present: “I am a team player.”**
**The immediate question this statement raises is “which team?” Because there is no “team” in Congress right now that fights for working people.** There are those who nakedly represent Wall Street and the war industry — in both parties. And then there are those who campaign for marginal change — who don’t want to antagonize party leaders or big business. Both teams are maintaining the rotten status quo in their own ways.
Kshama Sawant is not looking to join either “team,” but to go to war for working people against the billionaires and their political servants as she did for a decade on the Seattle City Council.
Far from having a strategy or willingness to fight the two warmongering parties, Chaudhry has made it clear she’s not prepared to fight in the way that Kshama did during her decade on Seattle City council.
**Chaudhry also has**[**said**](https://us.list-manage.com/XI_4tQCchPU?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)**about Adam Smith: “Our incumbent has done some great work on housing.”** She [said](https://us.list-manage.com/_X4atCfmgqc?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) about herself and Adam Smith: “In many fronts, we are aligned, honestly. So if you like how he votes for Green New Deal and housing and education stuff, you will like how I vote for all of that.”
NO, working people DON’T like how Adam Smith voted on all that stuff! Adam Smith voted to break the strike of the Railroad workers in 2022. He voted for hundreds of billions of dollars in cuts to Medicare and Medicaid. Under both Republican President Bush and Democratic President Obama, Adam Smith repeatedly voted to bail out the big banks after the Great Recession, which plundered the millions who faced home foreclosures and handed over tens of billions of dollars worth of real estate to private equity. This bipartisan robbery against working people is a big reason why rents have been skyrocketing. In 2011, Adam Smith voted to cut nearly a hundred billion dollars for various programs, including billions of dollars of cuts to publicly funded rent controlled housing.
How can working people trust someone who says they are in any way aligned with a politician who is literally bankrolling the genocide in Gaza and calling antiwar activists “[left-wing fascists](https://us.list-manage.com/F0dyj3ewIMK?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)”?
Adam Smith needs to go. Anyone who thinks Smith has done “great work” is not going to fight for the fundamental change we desperately need. Kshama is the only consistently anti-war, pro-worker candidate in this race. And she’s the only candidate with a record of taking on the billionaires and their political servants and defeating them.
Chaudhry [said,](https://us.list-manage.com/H4G54qsIWPK?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) in reference to Congress: “I cannot change the makeup of 535 people right now. I cannot convince 535 people of anything, but I can become one of them. Right?”
**That’s exactly wrong.** Kshama has shown what we need: a principled elected representative who will fight unambiguously for working people and use her elected office to build mass movements. Organized, militant, mass movements are what the Democrats and Republicans fear most of all and the only thing that forces them to concede. The last thing working and oppressed people need is another candidate campaigning to go to Congress to “become one of them.”
Seeking peace with the party leadership only leads to one thing: betraying working people.
We need to fight all out for every vote for Kshama in this election, by building the strongest grassroots canvassing campaign that Congressional District 9 has ever seen. We need to talk to hundreds of thousands of people about why our campaign represents the only real alternative to this rotten status quo, and why we need to elect a proven fighter like Kshama.
Volunteer, donate, and get involved in our historic campaign to elect the first-ever revolutionary socialist to the U.S. Congress.
In solidarity,Kshama for Congress

| Friend,
America is turning 250 years old this year. Under virtually any other president, a celebration of this magnitude would be a slam dunk. A unifying moment. A chance to reflect on what makes this country worth celebrating.
Instead, artist after artist is dropping out of Trump's planned celebration, refusing to perform at an event they see as a political prop. So what did Trump do? He went on social media to rant about it. He called the artists overpriced, boring, and whiny, and said the whole thing should just be scrapped for a giant MAGA rally with him speaking instead.
Trump has ruined America's birthday by making it all about himself.

The New York Public Library is celebrating America's 250th birthday by brewing beer from a 269-year-old [recipe written by George Washington himself](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQAL8GOqO1AZsULq6hy7VXosUsZC-OjWwnFn9_yv3C60ej0fy5L3dkz-H4jS-yZY9LoJo9lUJp4YQhl8RPys93RS45OkafaVGgtAAtYFg2ZH8tQ7vZnUhR35KVZoJRGyPH9mFRaj3hzezTIHenVurBoBnB9Fuv5Shbtl8baBgkwNQPHcnJuR4k3NAAjlszAG1cYur-Rg7lQbu_4odS5-Kr9fZRypmb_lej5kbNtdYuXKfvYjoaNZ-Jcm7UHKiKK6anON-rZyc8rwnTJTBsoqAnFCtREi4KDCG-g6MvQqlcwuNBqU12Oyt7z1mbZoDjhez_B5QfXftY9S8AAP__hVuDJQ). The low-alcohol brew was meant to keep troops hydrated when they couldn't trust the water. A local brewery is making two versions: one faithful to the original and one with modern tweaks for those who aren't feeling the molasses. Social Security's full retirement age just climbed again, and if you're thinking about retiring this year, the timing could permanently cost you. What's actually driving the change? ## Iran Strikes Kuwait Airport
Iranian missiles and drones [struck Kuwait International Airport](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D1uwzAMBeDT2JsMmf6RM2joki1dOxqMRCesZcuQmBi5feE2N-hEgASI972vy3hBDrzePnEhK1McV9pzIBFKIydcsySeKc-PHVlydIwh0wgaeqV7pdvRI4fX2JbeTkRATUm2NoPuemPqrrzbwUMNMIG7msGbrjmB7_0JHDpz7fppKtke33Sv21rroWkrqgfnGl3rExqNnS9aTZ4lpuo78ip3msIrPilVLi5lsHeRLRfNRwHnAs77vlfr1R2K435sYgq-gPOheQ-FIujmrP5Y6o1Uj6wcYaaJE6mN0JESDHNWkh7LppJbsWkHqJsyWb_tHALn3hStvi3I4TeP_KvEp4WfAAAA___o1oiM) on Wednesday, killing one person and injuring 63 others as the shaky ceasefire with the United States continued to unravel. Kuwait's military said it intercepted [13 missiles and 17 drones](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3u2zAQw59G3mToy5YzaChQGOjw79rRuEhn5xrZCqRLgrx94U7du5IAyR9_fS1fQJmO7SfsGHgty4HvlpEZ60IVjsaV7tjuzzcQtxIJcsPFKDNKNUrllgSUP4vrUlgRDdoOg_aTGkbv9dDdAnoc_LS6q41WJdT6oi-wTn70fpy0WTsKZ5oaldNKTdb1qKcYrdLqAl7BkIRTmIhL7X8XOviGa_6UF9Y-lr3L4cb8aMJ-E2YWZoZrPAn6rZy2MPOPg7EewFQOyMLMmV4on48EjE2Y-WSU_2qS6hZlzEB7k0D1Cg0lMEO8S1gZ69ljZ0rCftfWOj9Mw9DVkB5vypna6IVT2w6U_-7j_zr1FcyfAAAA__9EUIvL) since dawn. The U.S. shot down Iranian drones near the Strait of Hormuz and struck a military site on Iran's Qeshm Island. Meanwhile, President Trump said he was "perturbed" at Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu for "constantly fighting with Lebanon," endangering the ceasefire, and repeated that he would decide soon whether to sign a deal with Iran or resume the military campaign. Meanwhile, the American pilot of the F-15E [recently downed over Iran](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uwyAUhZ8Gb1jXGP8NDF28pWtHi8AlvgkxFpAgv33ltm_Q7UifdHS-83VZLpo8bbdP_USVXVg2LMljzhgXinpLOdID0-NVNOUUDGmfcBEgeg49B7lYTf5YZGWVQxTYVqiaYYSuH4amq1Y1yXHE1g7NICcUV2MRQHammSZjjXRdRepsgx5kAzC2ssZmNKaFBiY9gO4sk4CWcoj1PdCWV3T-CG-MtQnPyqs15z2x9oOJmYm5lFKbazotTs7EfEYmZke3NWPkd8x8Jx8yt6FsaPlpyfeIbwqv5A-e1j_Gf6WJu0i4WX9wRxGZmKuo7F7Ie0r9wCTcnpr8z5r8rwvfSnwHAAD__z6YiOo) was the same aviator shot down by Kuwaiti friendly fire at the start of the war, a coincidence one retired general compared to being struck by lightning twice.
## SpaceX Sets Record IPO Price
SpaceX is [pricing its IPO at a fixed $135 per share](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO4yAYBOCnwR3WbwwmV1Bc4y7XXmkR-In_NTYWkLB5-1XyCttMM9I30vy_LldLkY77P7ujqSEtB7YSsVbMC2V7lJppw7I9mqVakiMbCy4CxMRh4iAXbym-Ftl5ExAFjh2aQV9ATVoPqluN1uBRiGC90iHYoBzqoKS-Ka9GMaiOzFuDCeQAcBllj8PFuREG-GM1WOWZBPRUU-6_Eh11xRBf6Ym5d2nvollrPQsb_zIxMzG31np33Ny7ZGJ-00zM8ImRibmc1uE3pzPxUpPb-JnJIc_J-rKmxvdH2fq17rHLxp-NYqQyaSbhvluKn8n6q5-eRvwEAAD__9wrfCo) to raise a record $75 billion, more than triple the largest U.S. IPO ever, with a valuation of $1.75 trillion. The investor roadshow begins on Thursday. If successful at that price, Elon Musk's net worth would land at roughly [$988 billion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMGOpCAURb8Gd1QAEa0Fi9q4mKRnNcksDeqjfS2CgWc7_v3E-oXe3ntzcnP-fgwfDgPGz99uA0s-DRHOEoAI8oDZxUIZVyjrcTqkkiZ0ocCghDJcGC70MDsM16Cr2XoABXUFVradaEzbyqZarDZ-lMKLetZSjU03dqPxtemgezZPPzYV2psmjNBSiK7WD5DdNNVCiqdrhWtmpgXMSCk_vhJGWsCHK31Dfkxpq4JdiPbC6hdTPVP9eZ6PrcS7Y6qHyI_CVL-lCBdTPaWdF0rTeodldxP847gnvmecgJ_pCDPfD-LbUVb-dRTiZbl48pwyhoApOszACzl6Y13mr5fSv_44WWU77-c9KqZlWnxuDsP7If1I67dV_wMAAP__BkmOOQ), just short of making him the world's first trillionaire. His roughly 42% stake and 85% voting power would make SpaceX one of the most founder-controlled public companies in history. The company plans to [debut on the Nasdaq](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L3u4yAQBPCnwR3WgvFHCopr3OXaKy0C63gvGCyWxJe3PyWv8G-mGemn0fy5LldHkdL9t9vR1jUvCU-OWCuWhYpLXAs9kB_P01Hl7MlFxkWDHiQMEswSHMX3YppgV0SNXYNWjRP0wziqvtmsgdApoxFhckrpcbqFXk2hU964i1drQ_ajwQBGAUydaVFN3neg4OJGcH0QBjBQzaX9mynVDdf4zi8src97E-1W68Gi-yX0LPR8nmfr081_SqHnDy30DN9QQs98OI__JGNl6ZgCyucha5b9gcVjqjKvkjdXkCUlSUeWay4S9yPmNyJLl4JcC2EK3G51j02x4TgpRuJhFAbuu6P4XVZ_dOfL6v8BAAD___-RiaQ) on June 12 under the ticker SPCX, with up to 30% of shares reserved for retail investors, a move designed to tap into Musk's massive personal following.
## FBI Kills Man to End Hostage Standoff
The FBI [shot and killed a man](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2O6yAQxfGnwR0R4M8UFLdxl9tuaY1hsGczNhbgWHn7VfYVtj7ST0f_r8f0AGLal_-woS0hTjtembEUTBMl2HNJ9MT8PC-gkqMj4IyTUaaTqpOqmTwQv6em8jYgGqwrtLofVNv1vW6r1Xa90cG3LgQffGi1Bj17o2oHzg9ucBXZj6Y61Wilhrq5oR6cq5VWd-gVtF40Cj2VmG7fkfayYuB3fGG6ubhVbNdSjizqf8KMwowwu_4zCDMeMRdhxu3kQgejdMAUYtoJ5HwSe9qXLDm6p4_XLv2JEphxQS_nuM2yrAnhA-i7Maap78KMVbL-uIiZcteLRi0bEP_-KH-K97LmJwAA___6D4UF) who held 10 people hostage inside a downtown Bakersfield, California, office building for more than 15 hours, ending the standoff early Wednesday. All hostages were found unharmed. The suspect, Anthony Scott Searles-Harris, 41, a registered sex offender with a history of violence, [entered the Chase Bank building](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFugzAURb8GNtDDNrYzeOjClq4d0QM_wmsMjmwnKH9fUfUPuh3pSvfqnq_reEUOvN8-cSNXljjudORApVAaOeGeS-I75fvzQC45zowh0yhA6AZ0A2r0yOE9qtq7hUiQrMl1xkKvjen6enUapFWIUly6qddmskt_URa87dFID7pmd7aBBtUBWKla6uw8S-jgggaw95UC8lxiar8j72WlJbzji1I7x60Obi3lkSv5UYmhEsNxHO0-zeeLM6_EcGIlhmdu_mjCO6W8MAXfTHGbmrImwtLMK2Zq0ryjVLYzqk7OPw4OgbM2lYLbhhx-R8u_TL2c-AkAAP__qU59EA) Tuesday afternoon and made bomb threats before barricading himself inside with several people. The building also houses a [Kern County school district office](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOszAQhJ_GdEbGBgOFi7-hy99eiRZ7CXs4OPI6QXn7E_cK14000mi-7-s234AiHff_8EBX1jQfeHLEUjDPlOHgkmlH3l8nUOHkCSLjrJW2Ulmp2jkAxc_cVsGtiBpNha7pB9XZvm-6anMw9tZ6YztjFZoQRsR21ePiweNgoK_IXWvKqrZRajBtjc3gvVGNGqFX0AXRKgxUUq6_Ex1lwzV-0htz7dOjim4r5cnC_BN6Eno6z7P2C18UVy_0dEWhJw-R1pQPArnAscsFdsy8EsYg_QaM8pmYaYkot8QF7iiZygsKpUPoqcouPE-Kkdj2olX3B1D8fVD-pO3t9E8AAAD__yYVhJw). City Hall and police headquarters were locked down as a precaution while SWAT teams and negotiators surrounded the area. Two hostages were [released during overnight negotiations](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkM2O3CAQhJ8G3xi1Af_sgUOkyLfNJYpytNrQjDuDYQTsWn77aPYV9lyqUn3f3_f1HTlyuv_Cg2wLeU101kitUVm5YKqt8IPq4-NEbjU7xlhpVaBGCaMEs3rkeK2m8zYQKdId2X6aYRinqR-63Q5uCC6MiEFrp_SEAGabB3zzCqfZhI7taw1GMD3ArM2N-tk5DT284QQ4eGGAPLdcbv8yp7ZTiFf-pHJz-eii3Vt7VqF_CLUIteDmXgS3e37FQi1_fgu11IbJ5xDkR_JUTrwkhkZFbvnYZNsLYZOFnrk08tJh5JBLYpQbpsdXPZdL6IW90D97rQdtdA9dsf55coxcx0kYuB_I8etU-5bJT6v-BwAA__8ObIjG) before the FBI's Hostage Rescue Team moved in around 4:20 a.m.

Convention season is over, but the election season is just beginning...

#### **I AM RUNNING TO BE YOUR NEXT STATE AUDITOR.**

I have steadfastly communicated my intention to run straight through the August primary. That’s why I filed for candidacy last week ahead of the convention. No games, no buckling, no capitulating to a system with shifting rules and fuzzy deadlines. My team and I remain steadily on course.

---
---
Now it’s time for ALL VOTERS to get in the arena. Join me!

---
#### **The majority of Minnesota voters (99%) haven’t cast a vote yet! **
---
The August Primary offers EVERY voter an opportunity to select the candidate who will appear on the November ballot (not just the 1% who attended the convention).

I am eager for EVERY voice to be heard. Afterall, it’s the******ENDORSEMENT OF ALL MINNESOTANS** that truly matters!

**FUNDRAISING DOMINANCE, STATEWIDE NAME RECOGNITION,
AND SOLID EXPERIENCE SPANNING 40 YEARS...**
**
THESE ARE ESSENTIAL FACTORS FOR A STATEWIDE CANDIDATE TO WIN!!!**

💲While I will continue to fundraise for the general election, my campaign is financially well-positioned to run through the August 11 primary.

🙋My statewide name recognition, massive social media presence (+1 million followers), and database of over 192,000 supporters make reaching voters a CERTAINTY that my opponents can’t claim.

💼 For more than 40 years, I have built a record of LEADERSHIP, ACCOUNTABILITY & SERVICE:

* As a 10+ year **Audit Chair** for a $1 BILLION bank, I helped oversee financial controls, risk management, and accountability.

* As a **MN State Senator** , I helped oversee one of the largest portions of Minnesota's budget and fought to bring greater transparency to government.

* As a school board chair, business owner, physician, husband, father, and grandfather, I’ve spent my life making decisions that affect real people and real budgets.

**Visit my website for more information on my extensive experience:** [
Scott's Experience](http://email.mg.drscottjensen.com/c/eJxkz72O2zAQBOCnERuDxnL5tyxYHAIYKdKnDJZ_tgJJNERe_PqBr71uMPiKGf4saz1y_bOWiMoqFLkfk_N8F8qW1Iwy0qPP0jSqki03mVizSlQ4IIsSWwmom6hReQLrgQyJR8zI5JX2FCqwZ1VJezRE4AM1bVCsEQEdODBKARh_RShsvUmWtKLgw2Jgv1_LOXKf8289Rj2uue9ii485n2PRHwveFry9Xq_vasEbp_45r4-5b2KvY_D96yWEDOxTkrUxSgNQZXKgJKXsVC4QSiLRz_vbksbinEfZsKE0ZIMkaChdIJXZllaTFmcsz9e6betwfjFw33ndvnbO-Ovnoj8uvy9Hv5R-9HPBH-_8POsY4l_E_wEAAP__E8FyWQ) **
Winning this race is more than an endorsement...
**
It is about who can effectively communicate with voters across Minnesota.

It is about who can win a statewide election.

And most importantly, it is about who can restore confidence that our government is operating lawfully, efficiently, and transparently on behalf of taxpayers.

**⬆️ That is why I am running.
**
Over the coming weeks, I'll continue traveling the state, meeting voters, sharing my vision for the Auditor's Office, and earning your support.

If you would like to support these efforts, we invite you to consider making a contribution. Every donation helps us continue our work and reach more people.
[Dr. Scott Jensen | Donate to Further the Cause](http://email.mg.drscottjensen.com/c/eJwkj0-LHCEQRz9Ne1kctPxXHjwsgSGH3HMMpaWzHaZ1aN3k64fe3IrHe1A_-uS99lJ_7ZxAOw2ijL6orAtox7lZbWWAUKRtWCU5ajKTIZ2RKQIJTo0jmCZq0gGVCwotio9kHKFD68GTK-iNNj5SYONs4xwxiz2BAq-8slorZcMNFJMLNjs0GmOIm1XH48bnLGOt37XP2m9lHOKZPtZ6zc28b3Df4D5r-TzrjXrlsS7jYlcj_0eyjVMee-91jkUb3Hl0WlUcdU56fE1XsSgKOcvaCKRVqsrslZaYi9eFVeSMYpyPy0UD7H0A2aCBtOiiRNVA-oi6kONWsxFn4tff_fncpw-bVY-D9ufX8yv9-L6Z97efb3288ejj3ODbdb_OOqf4k-BfAAAA___LFXo2)
Minnesota taxpayers deserve an auditor who understands both the public and private sectors, and who has a proven record of LEADERSHIP.

Thank you for standing with me. Together, we can bring experienced leadership, fiscal accountability, and common-sense oversight back to state government.

Sincerely,

Scott Jensen
Republican Candidate for State Auditor

El Paso's federal court docket remains among the busiest immigration dockets in the country.

**" Top Texas Election Official to Resign, Months Before General Contest"** via [The New York Times](https://substack.com/redirect/3e46c795-de7e-4ab1-b27e-038649d7becf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)' **Lauren McGaughy** - The top election official in Texas, **Jane Nelson** , is stepping down next month, raising questions about why she is departing and who will administer the state's most closely watched election in a decade.

Ms. Nelson will serve as Texas secretary of state through July 17, formally resigning less than four months before the general election, her agency announced Tuesday. No further details were provided about why Ms. Nelson was leaving or who would replace her.

Gov. **Greg Abbott** , who appoints the person in the role, tapped Ms. Nelson for the job in 2023. A spokesman for the governor declined to provide additional information about her departure, saying only that an announcement would "be made at a later date."

Every statewide elected office is on the ballot this year, and the marquee matchup between **Ken Paxton** and **James Talarico** for the U.S. Senate is shaping up to be one of the most expensive and contested races of the year. In that contest, Mr. Talarico, the Democrat, is hoping to end his party's 30-plus-year losing streak at the top of the ticket. _([The New York Times](https://substack.com/redirect/3e46c795-de7e-4ab1-b27e-038649d7becf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Texas grid could see record levels of power demand this summer. Here's why."** via [Houston Chronicle](https://substack.com/redirect/92187988-630b-4dbc-9d5f-d6dbc501743e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Claire Hao** - Higher temperatures and the continued growth of large electricity users such as data centers could force Texas to use more power this summer than ever before, according to the Electric Reliability Council of Texas.

ERCOT, which operates the state's primary power grid, is forecasting that power demand on its system will reach 92 gigawatts this summer. That would top the previous ERCOT power demand record of 85.5 gigawatts, set during a record-breaking heat wave in summer 2023.

One gigawatt is enough power to supply approximately 250,000 households during the hottest summer days, according to ERCOT.

**" Texas using DPS records to confirm citizenship of voters flagged by federal database"** via [The Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/ccdb31d9-9342-4991-8789-47dd847f9fa9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Natalia Contreras** - The Texas Secretary of State's Office is now checking whether 2,724 registered voters it flagged as potential noncitizens may have already provided proof of citizenship to the Texas Department of Public Safety, Christina Adkins, elections division director, said during a meeting with county election administrators earlier this month. "It doesn't appear the proposal will achieve the necessary majority, but I'm glad we had the conversation." _([AAS](https://substack.com/redirect/13664edd-88ca-4341-8d8c-79c6852faa32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Dallas City Council approves $16M for southeast Dallas trail, part of the 50-mile Loop"** via [Dallas Morning News](https://substack.com/redirect/8d657813-7b8f-4934-abee-7b16a112c4d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s**Aria Jones** - The Trinity Forest Spine Trail, which cuts through southeast Dallas, will soon connect to miles of other pathways, along with Parkdale Lake, to expand pedestrian and bike access for the area.

The Dallas City Council greenlit a nearly $16.1 million construction contract to provide a 12-foot-wide trail which starts near Samuell Boulevard and Interstate 30. The project is part of a 50-mile loop around the city being headed by nonprofit The Loop Dallas. Neighborhoods like Buckner Terrace, Urbandale and Parkdale are expected to benefit from the Trinity Forest Spine stretch.

The work is expected to strengthen connections between neighborhoods "that have too often felt disconnected from the rest of our city and not had the option to use multimodal modes of transportation," said council member **Adam Bazaldua** , who represents areas the trail will serve.

"This investment will allow residents to experience their communities in new ways and create opportunities for people to get where they need to go, whether it's for transportation purposes or recreational purposes and just simply enjoying the outdoors," Bazaldua said at the council meeting _([DMN](https://substack.com/redirect/8d657813-7b8f-4934-abee-7b16a112c4d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Fort Worth to weigh local data center regulations as residents call for moratorium"** via [Fort Worth Star-Telegram](https://substack.com/redirect/477002d6-68b2-4d18-8341-462aab9a8543?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Emily Holshouser** - Will Fort Worth join cities across Texas and the United States in implementing development standards for new data centers later this year, or perhaps enact a temporary moratorium on the projects?

That was the question that Fort Worth City Council members began the process of weighing on June 2, during a long-awaited presentation on data centers from Fort Worth Assistant City Manager **Jesica McEachern** during the city council's work session meeting.

Data centers have become an increasingly prominent topic at Fort Worth City Council meetings as the developers behind multi-billion dollar projects have come to the city for rezoning requests and tax agreements. Meetings on the southeast and southwest edges of Fort Worth have been filled with residents expressing concerns about the environmental and health impacts of data center projects, as leaders in nearby cities struggle to get a seat at the table with developers.

The presentation was put together at the request of city council member **Michael Crain** earlier this year, with the goal of paving a path forward to balance potential economic development with those concerns from residents. The company Edged has been developing a data center near the intersection of Interstate 20 and Chapin School Road, located in Crain's council district. _([FWST](https://substack.com/redirect/477002d6-68b2-4d18-8341-462aab9a8543?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Next phase of $7B Frisco project coming soon"** via [Dallas Morning News](https://substack.com/redirect/57cf3a82-d749-439c-8b19-8e8a1eb6aada?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Nick Wooten** - The next phase of the $7 billion redevelopment of Frisco's Hall Park is coming soon.

Developer **Craig Hall** and his Hall Group firm are preparing to break ground on a new 10-story, Class A office building and expand Kaleidoscope Park. Construction on both projects is expected to begin next month and be completed in 2028. A groundbreaking event is set for June 10, the firm said.

The office building, called The Terraces Hall Park, will have more than 200,000 square feet of space above a 1,300-spot parking garage. There will be terraces on each floor of the building with an expansive terrace overlooking the park. About 60% of the building will be move-in-ready spec suites to meet the needs of small- to mid-sized tenants. The remaining building will be customizable shell space, the developer said.

The Dallas Morning News previously reported on the office building at 2801 Network Blvd. A filing with the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation estimated construction costs at just shy of $140 million. _([DMN](https://substack.com/redirect/57cf3a82-d749-439c-8b19-8e8a1eb6aada?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" $8 billion given to Texas public schools: Lawmakers revisit the funds"** via [KXAN](https://substack.com/redirect/a788df69-d849-412d-a785-d285112bf2c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Dylan McKim** - Last year, the Texas Legislature granted over $8 billion in funding to Texas public schools. On Monday, the Texas House Committee on Public Education met to review the implementation of House Bill 2 and discuss its impacts on teacher recruitment and retention and Special Education programs.

Lawmakers on both sides of the political aisle questioned members of the Texas Education Agency why some school districts that were expected to receive more revenue this year actually lost some money. State Rep. **Jeff Leach** , R-Plano, said the estimates, or "runs," that were provided to lawmakers last May when they were voting on the sweeping school finance bill were wrong. Leach said the bill actually "hurt" some of his districts.

"Had I known then what I know now, it probably would have changed the way that I voted on the bill," Leach said. **Paul Neuhoff** , the chief financial officer for Navarro ISD, told Nexstar that school finance has become so complicated that it is making it harder for districts to draft a budget because of the impact of other variables, like homestead exemptions.

"It has become more complicated as the legislature has added on more layers and more additions," Neuhoff explained. When introducing HB 2, author and State Rep. **Brad Buckley** , R-Salado, highlighted its unprecedented impact. "This is more money for Texas public education than any other piece of legislation in the history of the State," Buckley said from the House floor last April in the second reading of the bill. _([KXAN](https://substack.com/redirect/a788df69-d849-412d-a785-d285112bf2c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**TEXANS IN DC**
**" Texas Rep. Casar proposes tax on AI companies to fund jobs program"** via [KVUE](https://substack.com/redirect/972c2508-eb31-4ada-9f02-c9a1bf97d818?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Daniel Perreault** - Artificial intelligence is changing how we live, work and connect. Many people, whether they're entering the workforce or already in it, worry AI will take their jobs one day.

"Most people involved in artificial intelligence can agree on one thing," Austin-area U.S. Congressman **Greg Casar** (D-TX 35) wrote in an op-ed last week. "AI is coming for your job."

Casar is drawing inspiration from the New Deal-era Works Progress Administration of the 1930s and wants to create an AI tax-funded jobs program to combat potential mass unemployment related to AI.

The New Deal was a series of economic, social, and political reforms launched by U.S. President **Franklin D. Roosevelt** between 1933 and 1939 to provide relief, recovery and reform following the Great Depression. Casar said that "the kind of mass employment-creating program" like the one FDR created is necessary because AI could create "Great Depression-level unemployment." _([KVUE](https://substack.com/redirect/972c2508-eb31-4ada-9f02-c9a1bf97d818?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" ExxonMobil shareholders approve moving company's legal home from New Jersey to Texas"** via [KERA](https://substack.com/redirect/368847f7-06fa-4d58-b5ed-3189b7061fa9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Dylan Duke** - Gas and oil giant ExxonMobil will likely move its legal home from New Jersey to Texas after shareholders approved a proposal to do so, according to a preliminary count.

ExxonMobil's board of directors unanimously recommended the legal relocation in March, saying Texas' legal and regulatory environment was more business friendly.

"Aligning our legal home with our operating home, in a state that understands our business and has a stake in the company's success, is important." **Darren Woods** , ExxonMobil CEO, said at the time.

Two advisory firms, Glass Lewis and Institutional Shareholder Services, recommended against the relocation, arguing the move could allow Exxon to make it harder for shareholders to sue the company. _([KERA News](https://substack.com/redirect/368847f7-06fa-4d58-b5ed-3189b7061fa9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Samsung Electronics to move US headquarters from New Jersey to Texas"** via [The Korea Times](https://substack.com/redirect/2e5cf65f-5972-4c67-8aa4-4a4a978fe408?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) - Samsung Electronics plans to relocate the headquarters of its U.S. subsidiary from New Jersey to Texas later this year, industry sources said Monday. The company recently notified employees of its decision to move the office from Englewood Cliffs, New Jersey, to Plano, Texas.

The relocation comes just a year after Samsung Electronics moved its U.S. headquarters from Ridgefield Park, New Jersey, to the nearby Englewood Cliffs. "We are preparing for the relocation with the goal of completing the move within this year," a company official said on condition of anonymity. "After a thorough review, we will finalize plans for headquarters operations and workforce allocation."

About 1,000 employees currently work at the Englewood Cliffs headquarters, and most are expected to be reassigned to the new headquarters in Plano, while a small number will remain in New Jersey to support local office operations.

Industry observers said the move is aimed at enhancing synergies across Samsung's U.S. businesses, including its semiconductor and consumer electronics. Texas offers several advantages over other regions, including favorable tax policies and lower real estate costs, making it an increasingly attractive destination for major technology companies. _([The Korea Times](https://substack.com/redirect/2e5cf65f-5972-4c67-8aa4-4a4a978fe408?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Texas Business Court Is a Powerhouse for Resolving Civil Disputes" **via [Bloomberg Law News](https://substack.com/redirect/d4d4ac5c-3eeb-41f4-a588-3c36a4b58f27?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s**Sean Gorman** - Reports that **Elon Musk 's **Terafab chipmaking project is headed to Grimes County, Texas, highlight a broader trend--Texas is attracting semiconductor, advanced computing, data center, and energy-related investments on a scale that is reshaping the state's economic profile.

Terafab, a SpaceX project that has a potential total capital investment of $119 billion, is only the latest example. Samsung Electronics Co.'s $17 billion semiconductor plant under construction in Taylor, along with the steady expansion of advanced manufacturing and logistics infrastructure across the state, show how Texas has become a preferred location for capital-intensive, technology-driven industry.

Projects of that size predictably generate disputes over construction, supply, pricing, governance, and performance. The Texas Business Court reflects a recognition that such a large and complex economy needs a forum designed for those cases. And it addresses a familiar criticism from commercial litigants and their counsel: For complicated commercial disputes, Texas general civil courts aren't the most attractive forum.

Delaware, New York, and arbitration often became alternatives. Arbitration has a particular limitation, though, in that arbitral panels don't generate the public body of legal precedent that generates the predictability businesses need to evaluate risk and ground future agreements. Published opinions in Texas energy, infrastructure, and technology disputes matter beyond parties to the dispute because they can give companies and counsel guidance on recurring issues, making contract drafting and dispute outcome more predictable. _([Bloomberg Law News](https://substack.com/redirect/d4d4ac5c-3eeb-41f4-a588-3c36a4b58f27?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" SpaceX conducting third mishap investigation since January 2025"** via [MyRGV.com](https://substack.com/redirect/f1efb86a-152d-4957-81da-e62bd1310436?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Steve Clark** - SpaceX has landed Super Heavy boosters back at the launch site on three occasions, as well as in the Gulf of Mexico, following launch and stage separation from Starship minutes into the flight.

Super Heavy B19, the first Version 3 (V3) of the booster, did not manage a Gulf splashdown on May 22 as part of SpaceX's Starship Flight 12. Instead, the vehicle lost its engines prematurely, preventing a planned soft splashdown, and slammed into the waves at a high rate of speed.

"Looks like booster's coming in hot," noted a SpaceX live-stream commentator shortly before contact was lost with the booster. It's not clear whether the booster self-destructed before hitting the water or did so intact.

By Federal Aviation Administration standards, the incident was serious enough to warrant an investigation into why Super Heavy failed. "The FAA defines a mishap as meeting one of several criteria, including the failure to complete a launch or reentry as planned," the agency said. _([MY RGV](https://substack.com/redirect/f1efb86a-152d-4957-81da-e62bd1310436?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Neiman Marcus will close landmark downtown Dallas store"** via [Dallas News](https://substack.com/redirect/2ce6699a-14aa-4b56-825f-358a6aa15bb9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s Brian Womack - Pedestrians walk past the Neiman Marcus department store in downtown Dallas on Monday. The retailer's parent company, Saks Global, which acquired Neiman Marcus at the end of 2024, said the site will close at the end of September.

Neiman Marcus will close its downtown Dallas department store, ending months of speculation and delivering another blow to the central business district landscape.

The iconic store is set to shutter at the end of September as the company turns its focus on the NorthPark Center amid a bankruptcy process with Saks Global, which acquired Neiman Marcus at the end of 2024. The closure will close the chapter on a multidecade run for the retailer that had acted as a fashion beacon for the region.

"It is not an easy decision, but it is a final decision," said **Geoffroy van Raemdonck** , CEO of Saks Global. "The rationale is really we've looked at multiple criteria, but it's mostly the criteria of what are the customer preferences and where is demand, and what we see is that there's a shift in the retail map in Dallas." _([DMN](https://substack.com/redirect/2ce6699a-14aa-4b56-825f-358a6aa15bb9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

This is how Trump's America becomes permanent.

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | Today's Top Pick (ads) | • | Salem Media Group ---|--- • | Research Boulevard • | Weiss Ratings Plus | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Gov. Janet Mills and little-known competitor David Costello will appear on the ballot, but Platner was the prohibitive front-runner on May 11th when early voting in the primary began. It's likely that 30 percent or more of Democratic primary voters cast their ballots before news broke that Platner had admitted to sexting affairs with 6-12 women via the Kik app -- an app that is notorious for use among sexual deviants who prey on minors.

However, multiple sources have told me the emergency evacuation from the nation's capital was a crisis control move triggered by the campaign learning about a new and catastrophic story that will soon emerge from a major media outlet. The story will be worse than a Reddit history filled with racist and misogynistic diatribes, or hateful insults toward Purple Heart recipients. Worse than a Nazi brand he sported for 18 years. And worse than his proclivity for pissing on Taliban corpses or Portapotty self-pleasure.
Social media is inundated with speculation about what exactly this looming story will look like. I don't know the particulars of the story, but I know enough to say that all those people who believed Christine Blasey Ford was an unimpeachable truth-teller are suddenly going to find themselves in a very awkward position. But the point of this blog post is not to dissect what may or may not emerge about Platner's past and his lack of self-control. The point of this post is to explain what it would mean for Maine Democrats and the national Democrat machine if Platner were to suffer a fatal scandal that would, even by the most sycophantic standards, render him utterly incapable of winning against U.S. Sen. Susan Collins in the fall.
To be clear, Platner will be the nominee. Mills poked her head out to remind people that she's still on the ballot, but it doesn't really matter. The election was already over by that point. Maine Democrats' penchant for early voting means that a significant number of ballots were cast before Platner admitted to having 6-12 texting affairs with girls of unverified ages using an XXX app. Even more Democrats will have cast their ballots before this rumored story emerges. Which means that Platner will have effectively secured the nomination even as he sustains politically fatal damage -- if you believe that, at this point, there is a story so grotesque and unspeakable that it could cause Democrats to waver from the _blue no matter who_ mantra that has a cult-like grip on the Facebook-addicted baby-boomer BlueAnon class that now makes up the preponderance of the modern Democrat Party.
On June 9th, he's crowned the nominee. Here's where things get interesting. Maine Democrats can do nothing whatsoever to alter his status as the nominee unless he voluntarily terminates his candidacy. The governing statute here is Title 21-A, §374-A, which outlines how a potential vacancy can be filled, including a vacancy in the nominee position. But none of this applies unless Platner himself voluntarily relinquishes the nomination by filing the papers to terminate his candidacy. Sources who know Platner have told me that his galaxy-sized ego all but ensures this will never happen, but let's just game it out...

The new nominee would be hand-picked by the Maine Democratic state committee via a majority vote. There is no provision for a runner-up in the RCV primary (like Janet Mills or David Costello) to automatically inherit the nomination. The Democratic state committee would select any qualified Democrat it wants, by majority vote, following its own charter and bylaws on top of the statute. The pick has to meet the constitutional qualifications for U.S. Senate -- at least 30 years old, nine years a U.S. citizen, and a Maine resident when elected -- and has to file an acceptance.
All of this would happen relatively quickly. The Democratic state committee would have to get it done by 5 p.m. on the fourth Monday in July, which is July 27. Make that deadline and the Secretary of State produces new general-election ballots, or amends and supplements the ones already printed. Two weeks, start to finish: withdraw by the 13th, replace by the 27th.
Regardless, the next few weeks should be entertaining for Susan Collins.

name: Dave Beckwith for Congress
subject: $40 trillion in debt and only one candidate who actually knows how to fix it.
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Dave Beckwith For Congress_
body:
Dave knows where the waste is. Here is what he's going to do about it.
| | | | [](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)
---
| | Dear Friend,
My name is Dave Beckwith, and I am running for Congress in Virginia's 10th District.
I am not a career politician. I am a retired United States Air Force Colonel with 30 years of service to this country, a former Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense, and a Loudoun County neighbor who has watched Washington make the same mistakes for decades without anyone being held accountable for them.
**I have had enough. And I think you have too.**
As America prepares to celebrate 250 years of freedom, our national debt is nearing $40 trillion.
_$40 trillion._ And growing by $2 trillion every year.
Not as an abstraction. Not as a talking point. As a real, compounding burden that lands on every working family trying to build a future, and on every child and grandchild who had no say in creating it.
The political class has spent decades pretending there will never be consequences.
**There will be.**

---
[](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)
_Click the image to contribute $11 today_

I spent years as a Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense managing some of the most complex budgets in the federal government. I know where the waste is. I know how Washington protects it. And I know exactly how we can start cutting the right things without gutting the services that families depend on.
This is not a campaign promise from someone who has never seen the inside of a federal budget. **This is a commitment from someone who has spent a career managing them.**
Now I am asking for something small but meaningful.
__**[I am asking you to chip in $11 today.](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)**__
One dollar for every year economists estimate it will take to balance our national budget if Washington starts making the hard decisions now. With real leadership, we can cut fraud, stop runaway spending, and grow our economy so America can finally get its fiscal house in order.
Your $11 sends a message that could not be clearer: no more excuses, no more blank checks, and no more passing the burden to our children.
We have come too far to leave anything on the table in these final weeks. I hope you will stand with me today.
| | | [CHIP IN $11 TODAY](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)
---

And if you are moved to give more, every single dollar goes directly toward sharing this message across VA-10. I am grateful for every bit of support, whatever the amount.
Now, let's get to work!
Warmly, Dave Beckwith

**Beckwith for Congress** _a balanced conservative voice for VA-10_

Friend, They tell us that the Deep South is **_"permanently red."_** They tell us that change isn't possible here, that the status quo is locked in, and that we should just lower our expectations and _get used to it._

**They couldn't be more __wrong.__** **____** What we saw happen on day one of early voting in South Carolina _completely_ shattered that myth. When the doors opened for the very first day of early primary voting next door, the political establishment expected a _quiet start._ Instead, voters sent a shockwave through the entire region. **Look at the official, certified numbers from just the first day of early voting.**
* **Day One Democratic Primary Ballots:_45,966_**
* **Day One Republican Primary Ballots:_10,340_**

That is a staggering 4-to-1 turnout advantage for Democrats on the very first day. This isn’t an anomaly. _This is the shape of things to come. _**That kind of overwhelming turnout proves there is a massive, unnourished hunger for new leadership across the South.** Voters are fundamentally exhausted by an _extreme,_ _neglectful status quo_ , and they are rushing to the ballot box to change it. _Right here in Tennessee,_ we are fighting that exact same battle. Everyday families are being squeezed while supermajority politicians play culture war games. **Jerri Green isn't just focused winning an election,_ she's committed to delivering real, tangible relief to Tennesseans, starting day one._** _**Jerri has a plan for Tennessee:**_
* **Lower the Cost of Living: **We will eliminate the state grocery tax to give working families immediate breathing room at the checkout counter.
* **Wipe Out Medical Debt: **Nashville is sitting on hundreds of millions of unspent federal funds. We will unlock those dollars to immediately pay off a billion dollars in medical debt for families in need.
* **Expand Healthcare & Protect Freedom: **We will expand Medicaid to keep our collapsing rural hospitals open, and we will fiercely defend reproductive freedom so women feel safe talking to their doctors again.
* **Fully Fund Public Schools:** We will stop the corporate voucher schemes that drain our neighborhoods and put those tax dollars back into our public school classrooms where they belong.

If South Carolina Democrats can turn out at a 4-to-1 ratio on day one of early voting, we can _absolutely_ build that exact same momentum right here in Tennessee. But a historic breakthrough doesn’t happen by accident. It requires _months_ of deep organizing infrastructure and the resources to fight back against the flood of special interest money backing our opponents. **Jerri has the _vision,_ the _record_ , and the drive to bring real leadership back to Nashville.
