Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The ballot simply shows up weeks before Election Day.
Some ballots are filled out the day they arrive. Others sit untouched until the weekend. Too many, most will argue, end up ignored. Eventually, a lot are mailed, taken to a drop box or walked into a polling center.
It’s the only system younger voters have ever known.
The Election Integrity Network would prefer something closer to the system Colorado left behind. In May, they released a 116-page handbook outlining what it believes election laws should look like across the country.

name: Andrew Friedson
subject: I voted NO
body:
I refuse to accept that higher taxes are the only answer.

| Peter,

The County Council voted on a budget that included tax increases on Montgomery County residents, including eliminating a $692 credit from every homeowner, which hits our seniors on fixed incomes and families in lower-priced homes the hardest.

**I voted NO** because I don’t believe you can make Montgomery County more affordable by making it more expensive to live here.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132718989/625444654/-1721553747?refcode=BLU_EM_AFMC_2026-06-04_1&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NDRhZGY3Ny00ODYwLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E1JIp5GaEdWcMe-BovCXHW9MTzhldA9cKD5kah7tFgU=)
Families across our county are already stretched thin.

Housing costs are rising. Groceries cost more. Utility bills are surging. Childcare is expensive. People who have spent their whole lives building a future here are being priced out of our community. We are losing middle-income residents at an alarming rate.

_**I refuse to accept that higher taxes are the only answer.**_ That is why I stood firm and voted against eliminating the $692 credit while others who initially opposed it eventually voted for it. This race represents a clear choice on affordability.

I voted NO because I don’t believe you can make Montgomery County more affordable by making it more expensive to live here. = Families across our county are already stretched thin. Housing costs are rising. Groceries cost more. Utility bills are surging. Childcare is expensive. People who have spent their whole lives building a future here are being priced out of our community. We are losing middle-income residents at an alarming rate. I refuse to accept that higher taxes are the only answer. That is why I stood firm and voted against eliminating the $692 credit while others who initially opposed it eventually voted for it. This race represents a clear choice on affordability. body:
Families in Northwest Washington are struggling to afford their skyrocketing rent and do not know if they will ever be able to buy a house of their own.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132719019/625444688/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NjRhZGY3Ny00ODYwLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wv74OiCkwOOGZGYFVLFguHCI6f-qrkZPtIhvbH45VTY=&emci=ef5875c3-d75d-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=764adf77-4860-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&ceid=9494239)
---

| | **Families in Northwest Washington are struggling to afford their skyrocketing rent and do not know if they will ever be able to buy a house of their own.** That is why I voted for comprehensive, bipartisan legislation to make housing more affordable across the United States (_the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act_). This bill is not a be-all-and-end-all fix to the housing affordability crisis, but it provides real solutions to the barriers in the way of constructing more affordable housing and the challenges that renters face. _The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act_ would:
* Expand the number of homes, apartment complexes, and other housing options by reducing unnecessary regulatory barriers to new home construction.
* Prevent private equity firms from buying significant numbers of single family homes.
* Create a renter complaint hotline and resource center for reporting, monitoring and resolving renter disputes with large institutional investor landlords.
* Establish procedures for timely responses by the Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) and large institutional landlords and connects renters with State authorities.
* Require annual reporting on renter disputes and annual notification by large institutional landlords to HUD about the number and location of their properties.
* Support community financial institutions that provide critical financing to homebuyers and housing developers.

Our economy should work for everyone, but right now, too many hard-working people are struggling to make ends meet. I will continue to fight for the families of Northwest Washington and work to address rising costs. Meet
Trump’s most recent judicial nominee: Matthew Byrne.

For decades, Byrne has worn his extremist views on his sleeve. He sought
endorsements from anti-abortion groups, declared that his "pro-life
credentials cannot be questioned," and served on the board of an
anti-abortion crisis pregnancy center.

His judicial heroes? Thomas and Gorsuch — two of the six justices who
overturned Roe v. Wade, and whose lead Byrne has made clear he'd follow.^1

This is not someone who will check his personal views at the courthouse
door, and his record confirms it.

When Ohio voters enshrined reproductive freedom in their state
constitution in 2023, Byrne was one of two dissenting votes against
honoring the will of the voters.

And his extremism doesn’t stop there. Byrne has repeatedly misgendered
transgender individuals in his written opinions and opposed marriage
equality, making clear that his agenda reaches far beyond abortion rights.

This is a judge who has spent decades auditioning for the Trump judicial
pipeline, and now Trump is rewarding him for it.

Demand Justice was created to fight back against exactly this kind of
judicial takeover. If we don’t stop nominees like Matthew Byrne now, the
consequences will last generations.

On Tuesday, CBS News fired Scott Pelley — a "60 Minutes" correspondent for more than two decades — one day after he stood up in a staff meeting and accused the network's new editor-in-chief of trying to destroy the most important newsmagazine in America:

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132720261/625448826/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTI0OWQzNWUtNGM2MC1mMTExLThmY2ItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=aWXcKV_dMNlSIVOMCfYpjPIacb2nAoLofTBb_w8nOPQ=&emci=4e49d35e-4c60-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&emdi=5249d35e-4c60-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
On Tuesday, CBS News fired Scott Pelley — a "60 Minutes" correspondent for more than two decades — one day after he stood up in a staff meeting and accused the network's new editor-in-chief of trying to destroy the most important newsmagazine in America:
**"She is murdering '60 Minutes,'" Pelley said of Bari Weiss. "She was brought in to kill it, and she's been doing exactly that."**
He got applause from the room. Then he got fired.
[**If you're ready to fund journalism that can't be bought, can't be bullied, and won't be silenced, chip in to COURIER now.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132720262/625448827/90330534?refcode=20260604_60 Mins&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTI0OWQzNWUtNGM2MC1mMTExLThmY2ItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=aWXcKV_dMNlSIVOMCfYpjPIacb2nAoLofTBb_w8nOPQ=)
[Donate](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132720263/625448828/90330534?refcode=20260604_60 Mins&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTI0OWQzNWUtNGM2MC1mMTExLThmY2ItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=aWXcKV_dMNlSIVOMCfYpjPIacb2nAoLofTBb_w8nOPQ=)
Here's what's really happening at CBS.
Weiss took over last fall. Since then she's forced out executive producer Tanya Simon and correspondents Cecilia Vega and Sharyn Alfonsi. With Pelley gone, only three correspondents are left standing. She installed a former tech journalist with no newsmagazine experience to run the place.
**This isn't a personnel shuffle. It's a hollowing-out of a once-vital American news organization.**
By now, you know why this is happening.
Paramount — CBS's parent company — settled Donald Trump's bogus lawsuit over a "60 Minutes" segment rather than fight it in court, all while it was trying to close its sale to Skydance.
That was the first crack. But the chipping away at CBS's integrity didn't stop there. Late last year, Weiss held a finished story about migrants the U.S. shipped to a brutal prison in El Salvador, demanding extra steps that had the unmistakable look of placating the Trump administration.
The pattern is everywhere now. One by one, the legacy news giants that used to sustain American democracy, are deciding it's safer to bend than to report.
**That's exactly why COURIER exists.**
COURIER is independent and funded by readers — people like you — which means the only people we answer to are the ones we're reporting for.
We're in 20 local newsrooms across the battleground states where this fight will be decided, reaching millions of people the networks have already written off. While CBS shrinks, we're building. While they go quiet, we get louder.
**The midterms are five months away. The country is about to need real journalism more than it has in a generation — and the outlets that used to provide it are firing the people who still believe in it.**
[**We can't replace "60 Minutes." But we can refuse to disappear the way it's being made to. That takes resources, and it takes them now.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132720264/625448829/90330534?refcode=20260604_60 Mins&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTI0OWQzNWUtNGM2MC1mMTExLThmY2ItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=aWXcKV_dMNlSIVOMCfYpjPIacb2nAoLofTBb_w8nOPQ=)

As a veteran and a devoted family man, Mike understands the stakes of the fight we are in. He has been a critical partner of mine in Washington, working to dismantle the deep state and rein in the reckless spending that has squeezed the pockets of every Ohioan. We cannot afford to lose Mike’s voice in Congress. While the media and the Democrats are pouring millions into Ohio to try and flip his seat, we need to make sure he has the resources to fight back. Investing in battleground districts like the 15th is the only way we protect our House majority and keep the momentum of the Trump administration moving forward. In a town full of talkers, Mike Carey is a doer. He doesn't back down, he doesn't flinch, and he never forgets who he represents. He asked me to reach out to my most trusted supporters—people like you—to help him cross the finish line. The Democrats want nothing more than to take back the House and stall our progress. body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240884%2E444211%2E7fsXx2)
If you move in Texas — across the street, across town — you have to manually re-register to vote. Every single time.
There’s no same day registration, no automatic update. There’s only a confusing system that's counting on you to figure it out yourself.
To fight back against this voter suppression, we've identified 440,000 Texans who have recently moved and are likely Democratic voters — who may not know they need to re-register.
This week, our partners are mailing voter registration forms to 150,000 Texans who have recently moved — 50,000 from out of state, 100,000 from within Texas. We’ll do two more waves of this outreach in July and August, reaching a total of 440,000 likely Democratic voters. But we know that sending a single mailer isn't enough.
**So Powered by People is running the chase, meaning we’ll connect with every single one of these Texans.**
Our volunteers will text and call every one of these voters — explaining why they need to re-register, walking them through how to complete the form, and tracking their registration all the way through the cycle.
**We'll need to raise $66,000 to cover the texts, calls, and contact data needed to reach all of these Texans.**

Derek – can I ask you something?
How do you feel about the housing market right now? I don't know about you, but the system looks pretty broken to me.
First-time homebuyers have the cards stacked against them. Hardworking families can't afford what's on the market. And it's only getting worse.
That's why I introduced my Whole-Home Repairs Act – grants and forgivable loans so families can make repairs, stay in their homes, and keep more housing available for everyone. My bill was included in the housing package that passed the Senate in a large bipartisan vote. It was moving. 💪
But now it could stall out, and we need to get this bill to the president's desk.

Peter, May was a full month for Chaz. Here is a look at some of what he has been up to. [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/xhBN4VXaIQu57X0rg-_10g~~/AAUS1hA~/dj9hu5kPnOLzboMLdElMcomufejwEquw5hVmCRJ44VUGGLdf027dnGzyDc8PlqbGK1gPNQZSTJaAmZxYriR2LY7q0Oy4exjNVRepTCjPH0Xvfyo5Tpx8ewSg6BBotlRYmOgxQJ27RQQgrA-SWd0wTgmsBRlf7x8NxA_JYyxz2Dq0r1HTe9Eh3Rzx43KYm_6I3-mCakUn9uJ4QfwCPbKv0OZfHEXgEvxGmCFFUmDGK8Setk--julr5hewbw2ItulVDCW6_wfL9tFa_QJ4JPDJJQ~~) **Community Banking:** There is something about watching Chaz walk into the same bank his dad walked him into as a kid, this time with his own child beside him. Community banks are woven into the fabric of towns like Columbia, and that is worth remembering. [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/GBGkfSxna5h02DmRS4tk2g~~/AAUS1hA~/dj9hu5kPnOLzboMLdElMcomufejwEquw5hVmCRJ44VUGGLdf027dnGzyDc8PlqbGK1gPNQZSTJaAmZxYriR2LY7q0Oy4exjNVRepTCjPH0Xvfyo5Tpx8ewSg6BBotlRYmOgxQJ27RQQgrA-SWd0wTgmsBRlf7x8NxA_JYyxz2Dq0r1HTe9Eh3Rzx43KYm_6IQ-lmQowt_mzC90SE-at3dumRDrolg2P1sqM8Z0mKYWxyyjEMu6Ab9Vt43mcjYSWDdM_2eRIcDJ-oLFw2b6VlqA~~) **Nashville and Middle Tennessee Building and Construction Trades Council:** Chaz joined the Building and Construction Trades Council in Nashville for a conversation about what working families actually need from their representatives in Washington. The energy in that room was something else. [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/_o6eEF0PFWY2ZEZ4yyNG2A~~/AAUS1hA~/dj9hu5kPnOLzboMLdElMcomufejwEquw5hVmCRJ44VUGGLdf027dnGzyDc8PlqbGK1gPNQZSTJaAmZxYriR2LY7q0Oy4exjNVRepTCjPH0Xvfyo5Tpx8ewSg6BBotlRYmOgxQJ27RQQgrA-SWd0wTgmsBRlf7x8NxA_JYyxz2Dq0r1HTe9Eh3Rzx43KYm_6I5bEY0hhKeDMWTD3953FcvB7U2Qs8xSnBDHXXTY6CrzaTs4hgx2mNJ9BUo7h4PpKAA8Eoj_XJSKgGh1Cjf6t7mw~~) **Some future leaders** showed up at one of our Columbia events. These kids are paying attention, and they deserve leaders who take the responsibility seriously. Our kids are watching. [****](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/chNzb52e5OF66H__u-EiIA~~/AAUS1hA~/dj9hu5kPnOLzboMLdElMcomufejwEquw5hVmCRJ44VUGGLdf027dnGzyDc8PlqbGK1gPNQZSTJaAmZxYriR2LY7q0Oy4exjNVRepTCjPH0Xvfyo5Tpx8ewSg6BBotlRYmOgxQJ27RQQgrA-SWd0wTgmsBRlf7x8NxA_JYyxz2Dq0r1HTe9Eh3Rzx43KYm_6I7X9_B-I51NRiTSw7x_W6XzwKxlgcLQ_ezrSTIG5bBvY6pP6fKc-Hbw5vs5-xhiG3dClMyp3f7HaepjWO3f5tOw~~)**Memorial Day:** Chaz spent the day the way a Tennessee Memorial Day should be spent, from Waffle House in Columbia to a farm tour in Hickman County, finishing the evening playing in the rain with his youngest. [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/wldC6xQX52IEdcKldevJ-g~~/AAUS1hA~/dj9hu5kPnOLzboMLdElMcomufejwEquw5hVmCRJ44VUGGLdf027dnGzyDc8PlqbGK1gPNQZSTJaAmZxYriR2LY7q0Oy4exjNVRepTCjPH0Xvfyo5Tpx8ewSg6BBotlRYmOgxQJ27RQQgrA-SWd0wTgmsBRlf7x8NxA_JYyxz2Dq0r1HTe9Eh3Rzx43KYm_6IxQ6y-SOwP4oLqjr-MbeziBhoa2eekA9DOXj-uaujgIODW-e24ZDH3tP5DR3r7nrSEhS2T3cbMIrGc-SJuStaIA~~) **Relaunch Day:** Columbia to Ripley, Chaz kicked off the campaign relaunch by starting the day in his hometown of Columbia and ending it in Ripley, his wife's hometown. [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/fH0qLO7JcO9jlSZO2KmpZA~~/AAUS1hA~/dj9hu5kPnOLzboMLdElMcomufejwEquw5hVmCRJ44VUGGLdf027dnGzyDc8PlqbGK1gPNQZSTJaAmZxYriR2LY7q0Oy4exjNVRepTCjPH0Xvfyo5Tpx8ewSg6BBotlRYmOgxQJ27RQQgrA-SWd0wTgmsBRlf7x8NxA_JYyxz2Dq0r1HTe9Eh3Rzx43KYm_6IsdgDV3JEtC5w_u2Q8obw8ajmlIFD3SQy4YVbN4gDAErIyMinlccaoRSyFMuK8sY9Gb_9w1PHOM6hpmRaDDPqEA~~) **Stopped by Mount Zion Bakery in Munford:** A stop at Mount Zion Bakery on the relaunch tour. Great food, great people, and exactly the kind of small business this district runs on. [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/iZIEjx5w363G58z0CgWZXw~~/AAUS1hA~/dj9hu5kPnOLzboMLdElMcomufejwEquw5hVmCRJ44VUGGLdf027dnGzyDc8PlqbGK1gPNQZSTJaAmZxYriR2LY7q0Oy4exjNVRepTCjPH0Xvfyo5Tpx8ewSg6BBotlRYmOgxQJ27RQQgrA-SWd0wTgmsBRlf7x8NxA_JYyxz2Dq0r1HTe9Eh3Rzx43KYm_6IVbzDlqLQU_geWgvD_rFKWonkiGxFJzZgG4qLthM2HJ4P1Y6xelmEUM91nhEq1AmJciDwQdS2eWjYWsrsBTgVdg~~) **Hickman County Tour:** Chaz spent time touring Hickman County, meeting small business owners and hearing what is on people's minds. [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/ODaI3h-H6nj5QeWBmaB19g~~/AAUS1hA~/dj9hu5kPnOLzboMLdElMcomufejwEquw5hVmCRJ44VUGGLdf027dnGzyDc8PlqbGK1gPNQZSTJaAmZxYriR2LY7q0Oy4exjNVRepTCjPH0Xvfyo5Tpx8ewSg6BBotlRYmOgxQJ27RQQgrA-SWd0wTgmsBRlf7x8NxA_JYyxz2Dq0r1HTe9Eh3Rzx43KYm_6IafRtdv8imuS-Ql7VyyLzdVcgbphA3Ia5PmHEUVNy3T34SsI_m_mZu-NdXewfKt3inqkdz-tU1rb0G-XWQK2-CQ~~) **Central Labor Council:** Chaz sat down with representatives of the Central Labor Council to talk about what working families need from Congress and what he intends to deliver when he gets there. — Team Molder _:_ | | [DONATE](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/lV_TrvabUTI97KAFGQOAdA~~/AAUS1hA~/tflxv3P2EZ102PoBsnznEuDKn--zFDAytYtL2tZtO_KZkV0AzFpB8qr-LwCK2XvxKYPyhSHphZ7F2I-xK0x3nRdp9yhmQCcgFR8qRnsX1oiU9jO0jt89Y4Sdt3T01QCssRIxVTLzW8EsYs8SieIFVzGsmgCqKIv3By0ByB2R8V6NONEWfX-1n99yNySEtokjMabrNX5QrxLlVJz9Z094ouEixD_dz13Uf_UFx9Q5WgDl-A2OmZH80Lh0maMmU3m4)

body:
---

---
Hi Derek — this is Herly Rosemond, the DNC’s Civic Engagement and Voter Protection Director. I wanted to reach out today to introduce myself and give you an update on voting rights in this country.
[**Before I begin, please consider chipping in to the DNC to power our work across the country. Your support will fund our fight to protect voting rights, organize nationwide, and help Democrats win up and down the ballot this year and into the future.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-june-2026-gfr?amount=7&refcode=em_20260604_7426_fr&refcode2=7426_22930333_e13knK&akid=7426%2E22930333%2Ee13knK)**
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-june-2026-gfr?amount=7&refcode=em_20260604_7426_fr&refcode2=7426_22930333_e13knK&akid=7426%2E22930333%2Ee13knK)**
I am the daughter of Haitian immigrants who never had the opportunity to vote in a democratic election in their home country. Determined that history would not repeat itself in America, they registered to vote after their naturalization ceremony and instilled in me the importance of exercising this fundamental right as Americans. That’s why I’ve spent the last 10 years working on elections up and down the ballot across the country, increasing access, curing ballots, and protecting people’s right to vote.
It’s my job at the DNC to lead my team in building and maintaining the systems that allow every eligible person to register, vote, and have their vote counted without unfair barriers, threats, or confusion. **We also track new laws, policies, and rules to identify threats to voting rights, which is what I’d like to talk about today.**
As you may well know, the Supreme Court’s decision in _Louisiana v. Callais_ is already posing a major threat to voting rights this year as we head into midterm elections. Since this decision, we’ve seen states like Louisiana, Tennessee, Mississippi, Alabama, and Florida rush to redraw their maps to silence Black and Brown voters and effectively rig November’s elections in Republicans’ favor.
**But here’s the truth, Derek: They wouldn’t be trying this hard to cheat if they weren’t scared. They know voters will send a message this Election Day, so the only thing they can think to do is dilute the opposition to their agenda as much as possible so they don’t have to hear our message.**
It’s our job to fight like hell to make sure voters are able to make their voices heard this November. **So here are just a few things we’re doing to fight back:**
* We reached out to over 140K voters in Louisiana ahead of the May 16 election with voter education information.
* We sent over 62K texts to likely Democratic voters in Mississippi to ensure their voter registration is up to date.
* We’ve helped the Tennessee Democratic Party raise money as they scale up their volunteer recruitment and plan their next legal steps.

[**When you give to the DNC, work like this is what you’re funding. Thousands of Democrats across the country have already chipped in to help us organize, provide voter education, and register voters in key battleground states to help flip Congress and send a major message to Trump this year. Will you join them in pitching in $7 to the DNC today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-june-2026-gfr?amount=7&refcode=em_20260604_7426_fr&refcode2=7426_22930333_e13knK&akid=7426%2E22930333%2Ee13knK)

# Jerusalem Patriarch honors Trump with Holy Sepulchre Order
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1f9b5a03-5d1d-475d-a9d2-878d49d58043?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

Patriarch Theophilos III of Jerusalem met President Donald Trump in Washington today, where he awarded the president the Great Bearer of the Cross of the Order of Cross-Bearers of the Holy Sepulchre. One of the Greek Orthodox Patriarchate's highest honors, it is closely linked to the Church of the Holy Sepulchre, site of Jesus' burial and resurrection. The encounter highlights the Patriarchate's historic role in faith and diplomacy amid regional uncertainty.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1f9b5a03-5d1d-475d-a9d2-878d49d58043?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Ancient Holy Land Roots:** The Patriarchate stands as one of the oldest Christian institutions overseeing sacred sites across Israel, the Palestinian territories and Jordan.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1f9b5a03-5d1d-475d-a9d2-878d49d58043?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Key Religious Leadership Role:** The meeting underscores the quiet but important place of religious leadership in maintaining dialogue, protecting vulnerable communities and preserving communication channels.
* **Prior Royal Coronation Link:** Patriarch Theophilos III previously took part in the consecration of the coronation oil for King Charles III, prepared in Jerusalem and consecrated at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1f9b5a03-5d1d-475d-a9d2-878d49d58043?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Upcoming Greece Official Visit:** The Patriarch will arrive in Greece on Saturday ahead of the formal start of the visit on Monday.
* **Expected Russia Visit Follows:** An expected visit to Russia continues the Patriarch's wider international engagement to support Christian communities and safeguard holy places.

Peter, spring may be in full swing, but let’s get one thing straight: _**Our state was built by winter soldiers.**_
Let me tell you what I mean: Summer soldiers are willing to fight when the conditions are perfect. Winter soldiers are built different. They face the weather head on and march forward — much like Marylanders. They show up when times are hard.
**[I know this team can say the same. That’s why I have to ask: Can you chip in $5 or any amount to power our re-election campaign right now?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260604-1.mhE8JH&refcode=em-20260604-1&t=2&akid=1461%2E1086043%2EnKM29K)**
We’ve got our work cut out for us, but Aruna Miller and I are going to continue leading our state forward so we can deliver safety and affordability for families all across our state.
We’re not backing down. But we need this team behind us. Our opponents are going to come at us with everything they’ve got, all through this summer and fall, and we need the resources to go all across the state and fight their narratives.
**[So Peter, can you chip in your first $5 to help us keep fighting for progress in Maryland?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260604-1.mhE8JH&refcode=em-20260604-1&t=3&akid=1461%2E1086043%2EnKM29K)**

body:
It speaks volumes about the kind of team Mark’s built — e pluribus unum.
#

Team, in just a moment we’re going to ask you to add your name to the thousands of others who signed on to personally endorse Mark Kelly and his campaign.
If that’s all you need to hear, use this link and join them: [**https://act.markkelly.com/go/Endorse-0626**](https://act.markkelly.com/signup/mek-em-q22026-endorse/?source=em260604-1-MS2&akid=6491%2E6688874%2E4PY-LZ)
It’s fair to ask why this is important, particularly with so much going on. So, if you need a little more before you’ll sign on, give us a chance to explain.
Mark has spent his entire life in service to this country. From going to the Merchant Marine Academy, to commissioning as a Naval officer, flying attack aircraft in combat, becoming a test pilot, becoming an astronaut, launching into space four times, and commanding the space shuttle twice.
That alone is more than enough for any one person, but it didn’t stop there. As Trump rose to power, Mark stood up to answer the call again. He ran for Senate not once, but twice — and won both times.
The United States of America has asked a lot of Mark over the years, and he has never faltered. Not even when the President of the United States and the entire Executive Branch targeted Mark, personally, in an effort to stamp out his voice and silence millions of veterans.
But never, not once, did Mark face any of that alone. He has always had people backing him up, and that’s the most essential part of how he’s come this far. Mark couldn’t possibly do this on his own, and he needs exactly that kind of support right now.
That’s why your endorsement is so important. It speaks volumes about the kind of team Mark’s built — e pluribus unum. Out of many, one. We are all part of something far greater than any one of us.
[**So, please, if you are still with Mark and will be for whatever comes his way next, we’re humbly asking you to add your name to personally endorse him and his campaign.**](https://act.markkelly.com/signup/mek-em-q22026-endorse/?source=em260604-1-MS2&akid=6491%2E6688874%2E4PY-LZ)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.markkelly.com/signup/mek-em-q22026-endorse/?source=em260604-1-MS2&akid=6491%2E6688874%2E4PY-LZ)**
Thank you.
Team Kelly

Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate

Mark Kelly was a Captain in the U.S. Navy and astronaut. body:
| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=1&akid=10120%2E400544%2EgueJG9)

Hi friend, it's Deb Haaland. I am the daughter of Pueblo women, a single mother, a former small business owner, a former Congresswoman, and the first Native American Cabinet Secretary in U.S. history. **And now, thanks to your support, I am the official Democratic nominee for Governor of New Mexico.**
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/9511?refcode=jtk847-fr-nd&t=3&akid=10120%2E400544%2EgueJG9)

But no matter where I go and no matter what role I serve in, **I'm a proud Pueblo woman.** That's why I often wear my mocs or my ribbon skirt. These symbols remind me of how powerful traditional clothing is in sharing our heritage, and they remind me to honor the shoulders I stand on.

In a minute, I'm going to share some of the places I've rocked my ribbon skirt and mocs. [ _**But before I do, I have to ask:**_**_Will you please help fuel our fight to the general election by giving $5 to my campaign right now?_**](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10383?refcode=jtk847-fr-nd&t=4&akid=10120%2E400544%2EgueJG9)

| | On the day I was sworn in as Secretary of the Interior, I decided to wear my white moccasins and a handmade ribbon skirt adorned with butterflies, stars, and corn. No matter where I go, I am a proud Pueblo woman first — including at the Department of the Interior.
---
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/8175?refcode=jtk847-fr-nd&t=6&akid=10120%2E400544%2EgueJG9)
---

I am incredibly grateful that together, our administration made extraordinary accomplishments for Indian Country — enduring progress that would make our ancestors proud.
---
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/9511?refcode=jtk847-fr-nd&t=7&akid=10120%2E400544%2EgueJG9)

| | From my ancestral homelands here in New Mexico to the halls of Congress — and as I filed my candidate petition to add my name to New Mexico's ballot for Governor — I rock my ribbon skirt to honor my ancestors.
---
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/9511?refcode=jtk847-fr-nd&t=8&akid=10120%2E400544%2EgueJG9)

Friend, history has shown us there’s nothing we can’t accomplish when we work together, which is why I’m counting on the support of people like you as we fight for a New Mexico that works for everyone.
This race is heating up, friend, and I need your help. **I am ready to fight for an education that gives every child the chance to dream big and reach their full potential here in New Mexico. Give families a raise by increasing the minimum wage and the child tax credit. Protect affordable healthcare and expand access to treatment and recovery programs for those suffering from addiction. And now that I am the Democratic nominee, we are one step closer to making this vision a reality.
**
**_[Please, friend: Will you chip in $5 right now so we can build a strong campaign capable of winning this race and making history again?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10383?refcode=jtk847-fr-nd&t=9&akid=10120%2E400544%2EgueJG9)_**

Be fierce,
Deb

In a minute, I'm going to share some of the places I've rocked my ribbon skirt and mocs. | | | | On the day I was sworn in as Secretary of the Interior, I decided to wear my white moccasins and a handmade ribbon skirt adorned with butterflies, stars, and corn. No matter where I go, I am a proud Pueblo woman first — including at the Department of the Interior. | | On the first day of the White House Tribal Nations Summit in 2021, I wore my beaded moccasins in solidarity with our Indigenous people across the country. I am incredibly grateful that together, our administration made extraordinary accomplishments for Indian Country — enduring progress that would make our ancestors proud. | | From my ancestral homelands here in New Mexico to the halls of Congress — and as I filed my candidate petition to add my name to New Mexico's ballot for Governor — I rock my ribbon skirt to honor my ancestors. Friend, history has shown us there’s nothing we can’t accomplish when we work together, which is why I’m counting on the support of people like you as we fight for a New Mexico that works for everyone. This race is heating up, friend, and I need your help. I am ready to fight for an education that gives every child the chance to dream big and reach their full potential here in New Mexico. Give families a raise by increasing the minimum wage and the child tax credit. Protect affordable healthcare and expand access to treatment and recovery programs for those suffering from addiction. And now that I am the Democratic nominee, we are one step closer to making this vision a reality. | | I am so grateful for your support. Thank you for being by my side. Be fierce, Deb | | | | |

subject: Digital voting, poll worker recruiting, new states, and more this month!

body:
Open me for party news you can use!

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_june_26&n=1)
---
| Hello Forward Friends- I hope everyone is shaping up to have a lovely summer! We are ramping up our training offerings as we prepare for an intense GOTV season this fall. We will need all hands on deck for multiple things, so if you're interested in finding a way to get involved, check out the upcoming events below or respond to this email and we can chat. One of the roles we are recruiting for this year is **poll worker**. Our democracy depends on committed poll workers, and everyone benefits when elections run smoothly. We are building a _FWD Poll Crew_ to connect interested volunteers with official poll worker resources and local opportunities. If you've ever wanted to make a direct impact on Election Day, this is it! Fill out the quick 3 question form below to let us know you're in. | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=Cau9QZYSrELuaBTd-UPVTg_uZRAAURbaJm8u0pXjR0qpPxQ_pvYyU4Zc_2uPMlUa&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_june_26&n=2 "Become a Poll Worker!") [Become a Poll Worker!](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=Cau9QZYSrELuaBTd-UPVTg_uZRAAURbaJm8u0pXjR0qpPxQ_pvYyU4Zc_2uPMlUa&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_june_26&n=2)
---
**_New state parties:_**
In the last 6 months we have launched **10** new state parties! Congratulations to Illinois, Michigan, Missouri, Washington, Georgia, Alabama, Tennessee and our newest teams in Wisconsin, Indiana and Louisiana! If you are looking to be a team leader or just want to know what is going on in your state, reach out! New state teams can be reached at _(statename)_ @forwardparty.com, or you can reply to this email and I will connect you. __
**_Volunteer Spotlight:_**
This month we are recognizing **Collin Grier** in Maryland! He is not only a dedicated member of his state team, who are endorsing some awesome candidates this year, but he also does an incredible job on our [Veteran and Military Families committee](https://www.forwardparty.com/committees/?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_june_26&n=3), Amont the many things he handles is social media, which is so valuable. This movement doesn't grow without volunteers like Collin. We appreciate everything you do!
**_Upcoming Events:_**
**Mon June 8th @ 7pm ET** -[Make Your Voice Heard with DDP](https://home.forwardparty.com/make_your_voice_heard_with_digital_democracy_project?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_june_26&n=4)
* [Digital Democracy Project](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=lkWtgz3ihqpXtJhPnRXbMSVtTkMcsFycZ9KIKoxtHRZyemXMMX_1kwWJ8yV5owO7&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_june_26&n=5) allows voters to weigh in on legislation and shares the results with lawmakers. Learn more about this process and how you can participate!

**Tues June 9th @ 7:30pm ET** \- [National Volunteer Call](https://home.forwardparty.com/national_volunteer_call_20260609?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_june_26&n=6)
* Start here to plug into the work!

**June 15th @ 7:30pm ET** \- [Recruitment Training: How to talk about FWD](https://home.forwardparty.com/recruitment_training_june?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_june_26&n=7)
* Learn about the party and how to overcome common misconceptions.

**June 29th @ 6:30pm ET** \- [Welcome Team Training](https://home.forwardparty.com/welcome_team_intro_call_20260629?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_june_26&n=8)
* Learn how to call and welcome new supporters to the party!

You can find more things to do on our events [calendar!](https://home.forwardparty.com/public_calendar?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_june_26&n=9)
I hope to see some of you at an upcoming event or training. With our country's 250th birthday coming at a time where it feels hard to be patriotic, you can at least feel good about the work you do at Forward Party!
With gratitude,
Carrie Anne

Peter, I had to share the news with you.

| Peter,
Susan Collins here. I am writing to share some special news with you: I just cast my 10,000th consecutive vote in the United States Senate.
I have never missed a single day of work during my time in the Senate. Representing the hardworking people of Maine is the greatest honor of my life. Every vote I cast is with our local communities, our families, and our shared future in mind.
Thank you so much for your ongoing support and trust. I am proud to show up and do this work for you every single day.
[I hope I have your continued support as we work to keep moving Maine & America forward.](https://trk.email.goprelease.-PAGv4yw)

name: Nadine Smith, Color Of Change
subject: 19 Black members of Congress are now at risk of losing their seats
body:
[1]LeftNet

After the Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act, states wasted no
time dismantling majority-Black districts. The message is clear: if they
can't stop Black people from voting outright, they will redraw the maps
and change the rules until they have silenced our votes.

The consequences are immediate. Nineteen members of the Congressional
Black Caucus are now at risk of losing their seats. That includes Cleo
Fields in Louisiana, whose district was at the center of the Supreme Court
ruling, and Marc Veasey in Texas, whose district was already carved up to
dilute Black voting power.

Losing those seats means losing Black voices on schools, healthcare, and
housing for a decade or more.

There is one thing the Supreme Court did not touch: the power of getting
Black people registered to vote.

Voter registration is not paperwork. It is power. It is how we fight back.
That is why Color of Change is launching the Black Voter Registration
Program, the cornerstone of our 2026 Voter Protection Plan. Our goal is to
register 99,000 Black voters across six states before the midterms, enough
to protect the most at-risk seats and rebuild the registration floor that
suppression has eroded.

[ https://act.leftnet.org/go/22883?c0=blackvoterregistration26_l.75dUtw&refcode=em20260604-1649&t=1001&akid=1649%2E2118727%2EWbShPh ]Will you chip in $55 today to register five new Black voters? Every $11
registers one new voter.

Across Georgia, North Carolina, Mississippi, Virginia, Michigan, and
Louisiana, an estimated 494,000 eligible Black voters are not registered.
Half a million Black voices left out of our democracy in six states alone.

This is what voter suppression was designed to do. Create barriers,
confusion, and exhaustion. Weaken Black political power one policy choice
at a time.

We are building the infrastructure to fight back. We are partnering with
Civitech, the most independently audited voter registration program in the
country, to reach unregistered Black voters across the South and get them
on the rolls. The work happens now. The impact compounds. Once a new voter
is registered, they vote in 2026, 2028, 2030, and every election after.

This is how Black political power is built. It is exactly why the people
attacking voting rights are working so hard to dismantle the protections
our communities fought and died for.

They have the courts, the billionaires, the media platforms, and enormous
political power behind them. They are still afraid of Black people
organizing together.

They should be.

[ https://act.leftnet.org/go/22883?c0=blackvoterregistration26_l.75dUtw&refcode=em20260604-1649&t=1002&akid=1649%2E2118727%2EWbShPh ]Donate $55 today and register five Black voters through our 2026 Voter
Protection Plan.

The Voting Rights Act of 1965 was passed because Black people faced poll
taxes, literacy tests, and outright intimidation designed to keep them
from the ballot box. The barriers look different today. The goal is the
same. We will not allow it.

In solidarity,

Nadine Smith
President & CEO
Color Of Change

P.S. $55 registers five Black voters. Those five people will vote in 2026,
2028, 2030, and every election after that. The math compounds. [ https://act.leftnet.org/go/21583?c0=blackvoterregistration26_l.DhI2Kn&refcode=em20260604-1649&t=1003&akid=1649%2E2118727%2EWbShPh ]Chip in
today.

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.leftnet.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=1649%2E2118727%2EWbShPh

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

body:
#
When corporations and lobbyists spend money in an election, they expect something in return from those they spend it for.
So Alexandria just launched the End Corruption Caucus to stomp out corruption in government and restore the American people’s trust in their elected leaders.
**Dark money and special interests spend big money because they want to buy votes.**
Somehow in Washington, D.C. there is always money for conflict, war, and military escalation in the interest of the powerful — and yet, **there is never enough money for healthcare** , housing, childcare, wages, infrastructure, bridges, water, air, power, electricity, none of it.
We are at a crossroads in our country: oligarchy or democracy. But we cannot have both.
**Alexandria has made her choice.**
[ Alexandria is committed to fighting against the oligarchy that has created the nightmare we find ourselves in today. At this point, I do not know what it would take for voters in Los Angeles to wake up. They are beholden to their progressive values, no matter how destructive those values are towards their own quality of life. PolitiBrawl is a reader-supported publication. The criticisms of Pratt being "MAGA" for running a campaign on enforcing laws and stopping drug addicts from ruling the streets is revealing in the worst possible way. The progressives would rather go down with the ship instead of taking a life boat because the captain appears to be "MAGA." How do you break through that mindset? I have no idea. If Pratt does make it to the runoff, it will be an uphill battle as it can be certain he will not get many Raman voters. He will have to turnout voters who did not vote the first time. Still, Pratt is in high spirits since detectors believed he would not make it this far. It will be up to those same voters whether he will go any further. |
Peter,
A judge in Delaware just laid the foundation for Citizens United Part 2. And this sequel will definitely be worse than the original.
Citizens United vs. FEC was the landmark decision that broke our politics by opening the door to unlimited political spending. In its decision, SCOTUS ruled that corporations had a right to free speech, and equated speech to money. In the decade and a half since, elected officials and candidates have been forced to focus on appeasing billionaire funded superPACs instead of their constituents.
Citizens United made it possible for billionaire and corporate dark money networks to capture our government and the judiciary at every level. But this latest decision somehow has the potential to be even more catastrophic for democracy:

---
A court just ruled that corporations have the legal right to vote in American elections. Not to spend money. Not to donate. To vote. And the Supreme Court MAGA extremist Leonard Leo built with $1.6 billion in dark money will decide whether it spreads to every election in the country.
MAGA cannot win fair elections. Trump's approval is at historic lows, Republican congressional disapproval has hit 86%, and voters are furious. So they are changing the rules. They gutted the Voting Rights Act, seized voter records in eight states, voided primary results after ballots were already cast, and built a $1.8 billion slush fund to pay the January 6th insurrectionists they need when they declare the midterms rigged.
Every step is designed to ensure that what voters want no longer determines who holds power. And the Supreme Court is the institution making all of it legal.
In 2020, state Supreme Courts were the firewall that kept the election results intact. We have been rebuilding that firewall ever since. We won in Pennsylvania and Wisconsin. Nevada, Kentucky, Montana, Michigan, and Minnesota are next, and every one of them will be targeted by the same dark money machine running this entire operation.
And while we hold that line, Unpack Our Courts is building the movement to reform and rebalance the Supreme Court itself. If the state firewall fails, there is no backstop. If the court is not reformed before Trump places two or three more justices, the fascist takeover they are plotting becomes a reality.

These are huge victories. And they happened because people like you believed this fight was worth having. = | = = We’ve got a lot of leaders to celebrate today, but I want to lift up just a few who fought through competitive fields and showed what’s possible when we stand with real climate champions: ✅ Deb Haaland for New Mexico Governor: I’ve been working with Deb for years now, and I know exactly what kind of leader she is: someone who understands how the fossil fuel industry has taken advantage of our communities, and who has the experience and practical vision to protect New Mexico’s lands, waters, and air from Donald Trump and corporate polluters. ✅ Marissa Roy for LA City Attorney: The legal engine for environmental justice in Los Angeles is a position few talk about, but every corporate polluter fears — the Los Angeles City Attorney. As the second-largest city in the nation, LA has a unique chance to set the pace for climate justice. Marissa earned enough votes to advance to the general election as she works to unseat an incumbent and bring real accountability to this office. ✅ Yolanda Jarmillo for New Mexico House District 41: State and local races may not always capture national headlines, but they have the power to deliver transformative change for the people they represent. Yolanda won her competitive primary against a former state representative and industry lobbyist — bringing JanePAC-backed climate champions to 12 wins out of 13 races across New Mexico! Each of these victories brings us one step closer to the representation our communities deserve, but we cannot take a single one for granted. There’s no such thing as a guaranteed win when we’re up against Big Polluters. name: LCV Membership Team
subject: LAST CHANCE: Keep Big Oil out of the Arctic Refuge!
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM3NjUwNzUS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjQ4MDAzMzAzOAS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Peter, we wanted to bump this message from America to the top of your
inbox. The Trump administration is holding a lease sale for oil and gas drilling
in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge TOMORROW, and we need all hands on deck
to tell Big Oil not to bid on the Arctic Refuge — before it’s too late. We’re counting on you to make your voice heard. Add your name before midnight and send a message to Big Oil to stay out of the Arctic Refuge. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/k_ ADD YOUR NAME https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/rNykfEwyVAt- Thank you for standing with LCV to protect the Arctic Refuge. Read on for
America’s original email if you missed it. LCV Membership Team Tell Big Oil: Hands Off the Arctic Refuge

URGENT: This Friday, the Trump administration is holding a lease sale for oil and gas drilling in
the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge. The environmental movement must take action TODAY, before companies bid on
leases in this irreplaceable landscape. Tell Big Oil: Do not bid on the Arctic
Refuge!

The Arctic Refuge should be protected, not sold off to the highest bidder for oil and gas drilling. Decades of
leadership from the Gwich'in people and sustained pressure from people like you
have kept oil companies out of the Arctic Refuge, and it’s crucial that they stay out.

Tell Big Oil today: Do not bid on Arctic Refuge leases! Not now, not ever. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/~ ADD YOUR NAME https://links.messages.lcv. Peter, We cannot let Big Oil companies destroy the irreplaceable Arctic Refuge with oil
and gas drilling. For decades, the Gwich'in people have led the movement to keep
the Arctic Refuge free from corporate greed and extraction — no drilling, no
development. But that could all change this week. The Trump administration is holding a lease
sale this Friday, June 5th and Big Oil companies need to hear us loud and clear: Do not bid on Arctic Refuge
leases! Add your voice today and urge Big Oil to stay out of the Arctic Refuge. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/w_ywTKb_ Congressional Republicans enacted a law that mandates lease sales for the
Refuge, but nothing requires oil companies to participate — and so far, the
environmental movement has been able to hold the line to keep Big Oil out. We need to remind major oil companies that drilling in the Refuge is financially
risky, publicly unpopular, and incompatible with a rapidly changing Arctic. In
2019, BP pulled out of the Arctic and Alaska completely, signaling the clear risks for drilling. On top of that, not a single bidder
showed up in the most recent lease sale in 2025. Let’s keep the pressure up! LCV stands with the Gwich’in people and opposes lease sales on their sacred
lands, and in the entire region. If Arctic Refuge drilling were to occur, it
would have disastrous consequences for Indigenous communities, including the
Gwich'in people, as well as for our climate. The Arctic Refuge has endured decades of political attacks. It has survived
because Indigenous-led movements and people like you refuse to let oil companies
turn this region — essential for our shared human, animal, and environmental
well-being — into another oil and gas graveyard. Nothing justifies selling off one of the last wild places on earth. Join LCV in sending a clear message so oil companies stay out of the Arctic Refuge — take action today >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/j9y2f0~ Thank you for standing with LCV and with all the protectors of the Arctic Refuge
— so that this irreplaceable wilderness may continue to thrive for future
generations. America Fitzpatrick
Conservation Program Director

Peter,

Portland is beautiful, vibrant, and resilient. It’s where families build their futures and communities come together. Like every major city, we face real challenges — but spreading lies about our city only makes them harder to solve. Portland is a city worth supporting — not demonizing. No matter how long these attacks continue, Oregon will stand together and defend our values. # FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
June 4, 2026

**CONTACT:**

Todd Cheewing
Todd@Ascent-Strategic.com

**Lily Tang Williams Officially Files for Congress in New Hampshire's Second District**

CONCORD, N.H. — Today, Republican congressional candidate Lily Tang Williams officially filed her candidacy with the New Hampshire Secretary of State's Office, marking a major milestone in her campaign to represent New Hampshire's Second Congressional District in the United States House of Representatives.

Williams, an entrepreneur, legal immigrant from Communist China, and independent conservative, said she is running to restore fiscal responsibility, defend individual liberty, secure America's borders, and fight for the values that have made New Hampshire and America exceptional.

_"I am honored to officially file for Congress and continue this fight on behalf of the people of New Hampshire,"_ said Williams. _"I came to America legally from Communist China with just a few dollars in my pocket, but with hope and determination. The freedoms and opportunities I found here changed my life forever. Today, I am running to ensure that future generations of Americans enjoy those same freedoms and opportunities."_

Williams said voters throughout the district are increasingly concerned about inflation, federal spending, border security, government overreach, and the nation's unsustainable debt.
_"Washington is spending too much, borrowing too much, and interfering too much in the lives of everyday Americans,"_ Williams said. _"The people of New Hampshire deserve a strong, independent voice who will challenge the status quo and always put citizens before special interests."_

Williams has built a serious grassroots movement fueled by volunteers and supporters who believe Washington needs more citizen leaders and fewer career politicians. From the last federal campaign finance disclosure, she leads New Hampshire Republican federal candidates in individual grassroots contributions.

_"As someone who experienced life under communism, I know how precious freedom truly is,"_ Williams said. _"I will never stop fighting to protect the liberties guaranteed by our Constitution and to preserve the American Dream for our children and grandchildren."_

Williams pledged to continue meeting voters throughout New Hampshire's Second District and earning support through direct engagement with Granite Staters.

The New Hampshire primary election will be held on September 8, 2026.
**About Lily Tang Williams**

Born in China during Mao’s Cultural Revolution to working-class parents, Lily Tang Williams immigrated to the United States with nothing and built a life as an entrepreneur, educator, and community leader in Weare, NH. A living embodiment of the American Dream, she brings a uniquely powerful perspective to the fight for freedom and limited government.

In 2024, Williams won the Republican nomination and captured 47% of the general election vote against current incumbent Maggie Goodlander — coming closer than any Republican has in over a decade to flipping NH-02. She is back and running stronger than ever in 2026.

Hey there,
We are officially two months away from the primary 🎉.
But it’s actually closer than you think: **ballots are going to start dropping in just a few weeks.** Which means right now is our absolute last chance to reach out and talk to undecided voters. It was a red district, and local party leadership had pretty much already written me off. We were running on a shoestring budget, fueled almost entirely by people who just believed we could actually pull it off.
To be completely honest with you, I had no idea if we were going to win. I just knew we weren't going to stop, no matter what the establishment told us.
**And on election night, we ended up winning — not because party leaders made it happen, or because we had the largest budget. But because of our hard work.**
We proved everyone wrong then, and we can do it again now. But reaching those undecided voters and keeping our team out on the porch steps takes resources. We don't accept corporate PAC money — so I need you.

Hello,
I served in the United States Navy for 34 years and became a two-star admiral who served as the Senior Defense Official and Defense Attache in New Delhi, India, and as the Senior Director for South Asia on the National Security Council.

subject: Do you believe in my vision for New Mexico?

body:
| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=1&akid=10133%2E400544%2Exyqia9)
---
Friend: As the official Democratic nominee for Governor in New Mexico, I'd like to share with you my vision for our great state — **_[but first, can I ask you to take 30 seconds to personally endorse my campaign?](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/em_mw_202606_endorse_vision?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&source=jtk860-su-nd&refcode=jtk860-su-nd&t=2&akid=10133%2E400544%2Exyqia9)_**
| | [Add My Name](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/em_mw_202606_endorse_vision?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&source=jtk860-su-nd&refcode=jtk860-su-nd&t=3&akid=10133%2E400544%2Exyqia9)
---
This message is a bit on the longer side, but because you're invested in the future of New Mexico, I hope you'll take the time to read my plan. **As New Mexico’s next Governor, I will:**
**Build Education That Works for New Mexico by:**
* Ensuring students can read before third grade by identifying literacy challenges early and providing targeted support when children fall behind

* Strengthening early literacy screening, expanding bilingual and reading instruction, and investing in summer reading and after-school programs that reinforce learning beyond the school day

* Bolstering access to universal childcare, because learning begins long before a child enters a classroom

* Directing unspent dollars from the Public School Capital Outlay Fund to modernize and improve school facilities so kids can focus on learning

* Expanding outdoor and place-based learning through my Every Child Outdoor Initiative, giving schools the tools and resources to connect classroom instruction to real-world learning that improves engagement and outcomes

**Support New Mexico Families by:**
* Raising the minimum wage and eliminating predatory junk fees

* Passing Paid Family and Medical Leave so people don’t have to choose between caring for their family and making ends meet

* Increasing the child tax credit to put money back into your pockets

* Creating a statewide tenant bill of rights to make renting more affordable and more transparent

* Creating a Critical Sector Housing Fund for workers in critical sectors — like healthcare, behavioral health, social work, education, and more — to recruit more professionals to New Mexico to address endemic shortages that hold our people back

* Aggressively building more housing, eliminating unnecessary red tape, driving state investment into housing, and shortening the time it takes to build a home — and ensuring those homes are built with New Mexican labor

**Back Small Businesses by:**
* Establishing a permanent Office of Small Business to coordinate development programs, fill gaps left by federal cuts, and provide clear access to grants, capital, and state resources

* Cracking down on predatory lending by requiring full transparency in small-business loan disclosures

* Establishing a New Mexico Economic Growth Trust Fund to stabilize our economy in the face of federal uncertainty

**Fix Our Broken Healthcare System by:**
* Protecting and expanding access to healthcare in every part of New Mexico

* Banning medical debt from being included on credit reports

* Expanding New Mexico’s Health Care Affordability Fund to protect access for those who rely on the state marketplace

* Using budget surpluses to fill Medicaid gaps and hire more guides to help people enroll in and keep their benefits

* Ensuring sustainable funding for rural hospitals and clinics, expanding mobile health clinics, and significantly increasing access to outpatient behavioral and mental healthcare, including a full-scale effort to deliver mental health and homelessness assistance statewide

**Strengthen Public Safety by:**
* Ensuring that law enforcement has the tools, staffing, and technology they need to do their jobs effectively

* Investing in mental and behavioral healthcare, substance use treatment, rehabilitation, and housing stability

* Expanding violence intervention and prevention programs in schools and communities, building accountability systems that emphasize fairness and trust, and investing in community policing models that supplement traditional police work

* Creating a statewide Department of Community Safety staffed with social workers and counselors so law enforcement can focus on violent crime while people get the help they need

* Requiring ICE agents to clearly identify themselves and prohibiting masks that shield misconduct from accountability

New Mexico deserves steady leadership that’s ready on day one, leadership rooted in firsthand knowledge and experience. And after this week's definitive win, it's clear that New Mexicans are ready a leader who will fight for working families every step of the way. But the only way we'll be able to make this vision a reality is with strong grassroots support from people like you.
**I'm aiming to get 5,000 endorsements for my campaign before my midnight deadline to show the grassroots strength behind my vision for New Mexico, and I want you to be one of them._[Will you please take a quick moment to sign on now?](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/em_mw_202606_endorse_vision?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&source=jtk860-su-nd&refcode=jtk860-su-nd&t=4&akid=10133%2E400544%2Exyqia9)_**

---
Thank you for your support,

Deb

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Great news, bad news, and some more good news
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
In primary elections across the country, the people showed up and chose fearless, people-powered progressive leaders.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260604-6314-footer&t=1&akid=6314%2E420207%2EiCgsdA)
Peter,
**This week, we got some great news for our progressive movement.**
In Tuesday’s primary elections across the country, the people showed up and chose fearless, people-powered progressive leaders who they can trust to go to Congress and state legislatures to fight hard for working people.
A massive congratulations to Hilda Solis, Jane Kim, and Aisha Wahab in California, Deb Haaland in New Mexico, Analilia Mejia and Dr. Adam Hamawy in New Jersey, and Sam Forstag in Montana!
I was proud to endorse each of these progressive leaders. And if we can get them over the finish line in November, it will mean more fighters across the country pushing for Medicare for All. More voices demanding we put an end to Trump’s illegal war and finally put power back into the hands of working people. More leaders who will fight to protect families against ICE’s campaign of terror.
**And while this week’s wins are worth celebrating, I have some bad news too.**
The people who oppose our movement — far-right billionaires, AIPAC, and the corporate interests who want to protect their profits above all else — aren’t going anywhere.
They’re prepared to spend hundreds of millions of dollars to stop us this November. There will be misleading attack ads, astroturfed “field” campaigns, and more. They’re going to use every trick in the book to try and stop us from electing progressives who will put working people before corporate profits.
And if we’re not prepared to fight back, that’s the kind of money that can absolutely sway elections in their favor. We’ve seen it happen before.
**But luckily, there’s more good news.**
We’ve already shown that we can beat them. Voters are tired of do-nothing politicians who serve their biggest donors first, and they’re ready to elect fighters who will put the needs of working class people ahead of the profits of billionaires and giant corporations. This week’s results prove that.
We don’t need to match AIPAC, the corporate PACs, and the billionaires dollar for dollar. We just need the resources to run strong grassroots campaigns that can get the word out and mobilize voters to cast their ballots.
That’s where you come in. I’ve never taken a dime from corporate PACs or lobbyists. My campaign — and everything we do — is powered by grassroots supporters like you pitching in $5, $10, $20 at a time. And with November just around the corner, I’m counting on your support to help me win here in Seattle and continue supporting progressives across the country.
[**So Peter, if you’re ready to take our movement to the next level, will you pitch in $3 today to support my campaign?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260604.bxh8UJ&refcode=em20260604-6314&amount=3&t=2&akid=6314%2E420207%2EiCgsdA)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260604.bxh8UJ&amount=3&refcode=em20260604-6314&t=21&akid=6314%2E420207%2EiCgsdA)**
Thank you, thank you, thank you for your support.
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20260604-6314-footer&t=22&refcode2=6314_420207_iCgsdA&akid=6314%2E420207%2EiCgsdA)**

Peter, it’s Rob O’Neill, a Navy SEAL and proud American.

I was part of the heroic team that put Osama bin Laden in a body bag. Our pilots, aircrew, intel, QRF, and air support put it all on the line to accomplish the mission.

**In every fiber of my being, I am built to serve this country, and I will do whatever it takes to ensure America is safe and full of opportunity. **

What I have to say is for those committed to keeping America great. I am counting on you to rise to the occasion and fight for our country.

name: Francesca Hong
subject: Wisconsin is in the bottom six
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Francesca Hong
body:
We need universal childcare now
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260604-2880)
Peter,
Wisconsin is at the bottom of the class when it comes to childcare.
A recent [report](https://act.francescahong.com/go/13674?t=1&akid=2880%2E105371%2EwwNBsl) from the People’s Policy Project identified Wisconsin as one of only six states that put in the absolute minimum required to unlock federal childcare dollars. That's a choice the people running Madison made, and working families pay for it:
* Childcare costs about $15,000 a year, per child, for private care — more than in-state tuition.
* Childcare workers earn $13.55 an hour — less than a dog walker.
* Parents, mostly moms, are forced out of the workforce because the math doesn't work.

And it's bigger than Wisconsin. That same report ranks the United States 40th out of 41 wealthy countries on childcare — near dead last. Not because we're broke. We have about as much money per child as the countries at the very top. We just decided childcare is every family's private problem to solve alone, while places like Denmark, Finland, and Norway decided it's something a society does together — and built childcare parents can actually afford. It's a choice. We've been making the wrong one.
Our universal childcare policy would provide totally free childcare to most Wisconsin families and would aggressively cap costs for wealthier ones. It also provides a pay boost and additional support for childcare centers and childcare workers, like tuition reimbursements, making it easier and more sustainable to create the supply of childcare that Wisconsin families need.
You don't have to look across an ocean to see it work, either. In New York, the new mayor, Zohran Mamdani, made universal childcare the center of his campaign, and within months of taking office, the city started rolling out free childcare for two-year-olds, with 2,000 free seats opening this fall. A major American city is doing right now what we keep being told Wisconsin can't. The question was never whether we can afford to. It's whether we're willing to.
So here's how we pay for it: the same way we pay for Social Security and unemployment — everyone pitches in a little through payroll, workers and employers together, and everyone gets to use it. For a worker, that's about $6 to $8 a week, with employers covering the larger share. $24 per month versus $1,000 per month? Sounds like an easy choice to me.
I'm running for governor to make that choice. Other places already proved it works. Wisconsin can be next.
[If you believe raising a kid here shouldn't be a financial emergency, chip in $15 today — a dollar for every thousand a Wisconsin family pays per kid each year](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260603.AvI8mL&refcode=em20260604-2880&t=2&akid=2880%2E105371%2EwwNBsl)
Let's make better possible.
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260603.AvI8mL&amount=5&refcode=em20260604-2880&t=5&akid=2880%2E105371%2EwwNBsl)**
In solidarity,
Fran
**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_fh_footer?refcode=em20260604-2880&t=6&refcode2=2880_105371_wwNBsl&akid=2880%2E105371%2EwwNBsl)**
