Dear Peter,
Working-class people around the nation are fighting back against Big Tech billionaires who are pushing for a massive expansion of hyperscale data centers.
**Join Kshama Sawant this Sunday, June 7th, at 4pm PT to talk about the strategy to fight back against Big Tech.**
Already this year we have seen at least 115,000 employees laid off while major corporations are making historic profits and spending enormous amounts on AI infrastructure—especially data centers, chips, and electricity.
Estimates for 2026 suggest that Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and Meta together could spend roughly $725 billion in capital expenditures, have more profits than ever, and yet still lay off workers.
The billionaires and multimillionaires profiting from Big Tech are attempting to massively expand these huge data centers because they are closely linked to their ability to continue creating super profits.
They are advancing dystopian AI technologies that are designed to enable mass layoffs and systematically deprive many workers of stable employment, basic rights, and quality of life, while at the same time greatly enriching the billionaires.
Hyperscale data centers also cause enormous damage to the environment and drive down the living conditions of working people near them. They generate air pollution, sound pollution, noise pollution, and consume prodigious amounts of electrical power, which then drives up utility costs. Some billionaires are saying the _quiet part out loud_ , like [Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei](https://us.list-manage.com/RRTEaqd4NTa?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) who has repeatedly warned that **AI could significantly reduce demand for some entry-level white-collar jobs** ,**** and has called for policymakers to prepare for **large-scale labor-market disruption**.
But working people are fighting back. We’ve seen a number of the hyperscale data centers defeated or pushed back due to working class organizing in such towns as Pekin, IL where Workers Strike Back and community members organized against a planned 321-acre hyperscale data center, and they won!
The bosses claim that the AI layoffs are about ‘efficiency’, but we know that it is really a class war by the bosses against the working class. Capitalism itself is class war.
The strategy of class struggle is needed in every city hall, in every workplace, in every protest. Our methods for fighting back need to be crystal clear, that our allies are working people and NOT the political parties of the billionaires. A large majority of both the Democratic and Republican parties are bankrolled by Big Tech and ruthlessly represent its interests. [And nearly all (94%) of members of Congress with jurisdiction over privacy and antitrust issues have received money from Big Tech.](https://us.list-manage.com/D41_nqLT_QT?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
Kshama Sawant is an independent socialist and the only candidate in this race fighting to stop the data centers and AI layoffs and to take these reckless Big Tech corporations into democratic public ownership. If Big Tech CEOs are allowed to, they will continue to drive both living standards and the climate over the cliff.
**Kshama is the only candidate in this race fighting for a nationwide moratorium on data centers, for a living-wage jobs guarantee to counter the AI-related mass layoffs. Kshama is also the only candidate fighting to shut down ICE and for an end to all weapons and tech, including AI, for genocide and imperialist war.**
Kshama Sawant has an unparalleled track record as a fighter for working people and has again and again taken on the billionaires and won.
Kshama used her elected Seattle City Council position to build the mass movement that defeated Jeff Bezos to win the Amazon Tax, which funds hundreds of millions of dollars for affordable housing annually. She led movements that won the highest minimum wage in the nation, landmark renters' rights laws, Seattle’s Indigenous Peoples’ Day, free abortion, and much more.
Kshama’s main opponent, Democrat Adam Smith, wants over a trillion new dollars for wars and a shocking expansion in AI, cyber, biotech, and other weapons for Israel. Smith shamelessly serves the war profiteers! We need to build the strongest possible movement to elect Kshama to Congress.
The Democratic Party is utterly rotten. They are more afraid of working-class movements than they are of Trump. **Working people need a new party of our own**. We need a party of, by, and for working people, which fights against the bosses and their political servants like Kshama did in Seattle.
This campaign is a historic opportunity to elect a proven fighter and the first ever revolutionary socialist to the U.S. Congress!
Donate, volunteer, and join us on June 4th for our Town Hall to stop the data centers and AI layoffs!
Solidarity,Kshama for Congress

They are advancing dystopian AI technologies that are designed to enable mass layoffs and systematically deprive many workers of stable employment, basic rights, and quality of life, while at the same time greatly enriching the billionaires. Hyperscale data centers also cause enormous damage to the environment and drive down the living conditions of working people near them. They generate air pollution, sound pollution, noise pollution, and consume prodigious amounts of electrical power, which then drives up utility costs. Some billionaires are saying the quiet part out loud , like who has repeatedly warned that AI could significantly reduce demand for some entry-level white-collar jobs ,** and has called for policymakers to prepare for large-scale labor-market disruption. But working people are fighting back. We’ve seen a number of the hyperscale data centers defeated or pushed back due to working class organizing in such towns as Pekin, IL where Workers Strike Back and community members organized against a planned 321-acre hyperscale data center, and they won! The bosses claim that the AI layoffs are about ‘efficiency’, but we know that it is really a class war by the bosses against the working class. Capitalism itself is class war. The strategy of class struggle is needed in every city hall, in every workplace, in every protest. Our methods for fighting back need to be crystal clear, that our allies are working people and NOT the political parties of the billionaires. A large majority of both the Democratic and Republican parties are bankrolled by Big Tech and ruthlessly represent its interests. Kshama Sawant is an independent socialist and the only candidate in this race fighting to stop the data centers and AI layoffs and to take these reckless Big Tech corporations into democratic public ownership. If Big Tech CEOs are allowed to, they will continue to drive both living standards and the climate over the cliff. Kshama is the only candidate in this race fighting for a nationwide moratorium on data centers, for a living-wage jobs guarantee to counter the AI-related mass layoffs. Kshama is also the only candidate fighting to shut down ICE and for an end to all weapons and tech, including AI, for genocide and imperialist war. Kshama Sawant has an unparalleled track record as a fighter for working people and has again and again taken on the billionaires and won. Kshama used her elected Seattle City Council position to build the mass movement that defeated Jeff Bezos to win the Amazon Tax, which funds hundreds of millions of dollars for affordable housing annually. She led movements that won the highest minimum wage in the nation, landmark renters' rights laws, Seattle’s Indigenous Peoples’ Day, free abortion, and much more. Kshama’s main opponent, Democrat Adam Smith, wants over a trillion new dollars for wars and a shocking expansion in AI, cyber, biotech, and other weapons for Israel. Smith shamelessly serves the war profiteers! We need to build the strongest possible movement to elect Kshama to Congress. The Democratic Party is utterly rotten. They are more afraid of working-class movements than they are of Trump. Working people need a new party of our own. We need a party of, by, and for working people, which fights against the bosses and their political servants like Kshama did in Seattle. This campaign is a historic opportunity to elect a proven fighter and the first ever revolutionary socialist to the U.S. Congress! Donate, volunteer, and join us on June 4th for our Town Hall to stop the data centers and AI layoffs! Attend in person in Tukwila, WA, or via livestream.** | | | | | | | | | | Help us build an independent fight for free healthcare for all and millions of affordable homes, funded by taxing the rich, and for a living-wage jobs guarantee, national rent control, and a $25/hour minimum wage. We’re fighting to shut down ICE, to end all military aid to Israel, and stop the data centers and AI-related layoffs. We need a new party for the working class! | | The billionaires and their two parties will fight tooth and nail to keep Kshama out of Congress because they know she is a real fighter for working people. name: Josh Shapiro
subject: Why school breakfast?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA]
body:
[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Derek,

I wanted to take a little more time to
explain why our first ad of the general election is about free school
breakfast: To me, this is exactly what public service is supposed to look
like.

No kid should start the school day hungry. No parent should have to worry
that their child is sitting in class trying to focus on an empty stomach.
And no student’s ability to learn should depend on whether breakfast was
affordable or available that morning.

When I became Governor, we got to work. And today, 1.7 million students
across Pennsylvania have access to free breakfast at school – giving kids
a stronger start to their day and giving working families a little more
breathing room.

That’s not a partisan issue. That’s common sense,
Derek.

And it’s the kind of thing that happens when leaders bring people together
and focus on getting stuff done.

That’s why I wanted this ad to be one of the first messages voters hear
from our campaign in the general election.

Because this race isn’t just about what the far-right is trying to tear
down. It’s about what we can keep building together: A Commonwealth where
government actually works for the people it serves.

But getting our message out in front of voters is expensive.

Pennsylvania is one of the toughest battleground states in the country
with multiple major media markets, and a far-right opponent whose allies
are already trying to define this race with attacks and misinformation. If
we want our message to keep reaching the thousands of undecided voters who
will decide the outcome of this election, we need the resources to keep it
running.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/1286?t=1001&akid=63%2E245147%2Egb0KrN ]Derek, I want
this election to be about the people of Pennsylvania — kids who deserve a
fair shot, parents trying to make ends meet, and families who want leaders
focused on solving real problems. That’s what this ad is about, and it’s
why I’m asking for your support one more time before the day ends: Will
you chip in $25 (or whatever you can!) to help us hit our Ads Fund goal so
we can reach voters all across Pennsylvania?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:
